Entries.Title: Marry My Husband
Entries.Description: Kang Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, is killed by her husband and best friend after she witnesses them having an affair. She wakes up 10 years before the incident and decides to seek revenge with the help of Yu Ji-hyuk, a director at the company where she works. Now, she must reclaim her fate and eliminate the trash from her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ji-won believed that Su-min would always have her back until she discovered that Su-min was having an affair with her husband. Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, witnesses the two in bed discussing her insurance payout. She ends up not being able to live out the remaining days of her numbered life before she's killed... But then she suddenly wakes up, and it's 2013?!

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ji-won has gone back 10 years in time and learns that events will unfold as they are meant to according to the law of destiny. In an attempt to pass on her fate to Su-min, she tries to set up her future husband, Park Min-hwan, with her... However, Su-min's sly manipulation becomes more apparent to Ji-won, and now it's her turn to counterattack!

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yu Ji-hyuk had no connections with Ji-won in her previous life, but he is gradually becoming involved in her current life. Su-min invites Ji-won to a school reunion to resurrect the shameful memories of when she was ostracized in high school. Ji-won sees through Su-min's intentions, and with the help of her colleagues, she undergoes a transformation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ji-won attends an event with Ji-hyeok and meets someone who will be a future topic of discussion. Ji-hyuk becomes concerned as he observes Ji-won's transformation. After a heated encounter at the high school reunion, Su-min becomes even more obsessed with Ji-won. Meanwhile, as Ji-won tries to provoke Su-min with Min-hwan, she unexpectedly discovers a secret about Ji-hyuk during a work errand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk reminisces about his first encounter with Ji-won eight years ago. His sole purpose in coming back is now Ji-won. Su-min manipulates Mr. Kim to steal Ji-won's proposal, while Ji-hyuk tries to assist Ji-won. However, due to misunderstandings stemming from his relationship with Hui-yeon, Ji-won ends up getting angry at Ji-hyuk instead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk confesses his feelings to Ji-won, but she has no time to contemplate her own emotions for him. As Ji-won attempts to overcome her destiny and confront forces opposing the original direction of her fate, her name is ultimately omitted from the proposal. Ji-hyuk empowers Ji-won to take a stand and fight, while Ji-won recalls a future known only to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The two have discovered that they both traveled back in time! While Ji-won is thrilled to find a comrade, Ji-hyuk starts to avoid her. He suffers alone after learning of the cruel laws of time travel too late. Meanwhile, Ji-won goes on a picnic with Su-min and Min-hwan, managing to leave the two behind. On her way back, she runs into Ji-hyuk, who appears to have sorted out his thoughts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: During the company's autumn workshop, Ji-won and Su-min engage in a fierce battle of wits. It's the first time they confront each other so sincerely. Su-min becomes angry and attempts to cross the line to hurt Ji-won. Eventually, an incident occurs at a supermarket tasting event involving Min-hwan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: With Ji-hyuk's help, Min-hwan proposes to Ji-won. Ji-won spreads rumors at work to start a buzz. Su-min is upset and intentionally tries to turn Min-hwan's mother and Ji-won into enemies to ruin the engagement dinner. However, the night of the dinner arrives, and it's the day Ji-won has been waiting for.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ji-won ruins the engagement dinner, leaving Min-hwan utterly embarrassed. Employees soon gossip that Ji-won and Min-hwan's engagement has been called off, and he's been cheating with Su-min. Su-min tries to cover it up, but because of her lies, the supermarket incident resurfaces. She's now caught in a crisis and ends up dropping the bomb.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: They finally kiss. Ji-won is going full power towards him, while he continually tries to hit the brakes. Eventually, he ends up opening up to Ji-won. On the other hand, Su-min and Min-hwan speed up the wedding due to an unexpected pregnancy, and Ji-won shows up with Ji-hyuk as her date, aiming to outshine the bride.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk's fiancée, Yu-ra, makes an appearance and creates a rift between Ji-hyuk and Ji-won. Moreover, Ji-won is surprised to hear about Ju-ran's stomach cancer. She is shocked to realize that her fate wasn't passed on to Su-min. Meanwhile, Su-min and Min-hwan, spending their newlywed days discontentedly, acquire information about Ji-hyuk that enrages them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: After an accident that was intended to harm Ji-won, Ji-hyuk gets injured instead and falls into a coma. Ji-won is scared that Ji-hyuk may never wake up. With everyone involved in the accident busy covering their tracks, Ji-won learns the truth behind the accident and seeks out Su-min to confront her memories from a distant past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk regains consciousness and quietly trails the person involved in the accident that Yu-ra is trying to conceal. Meanwhile, Ji-won realizes that, in order to pass on her fate to Su-min, she must get Min-hwan to have an affair. Ji-won decides to become Min-hwan's secret lover, pretends to break up with Ji-hyuk, and approaches Min-hwan once more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Su-min meets Yu-ra and presents compelling evidence, prompting Yu-ra to start finding a way to resolve the situation once and for all. Ji-won and Ji-hyuk initiate their final operations toward Min-hwan and Su-min, finally bringing about the night of destiny!

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: With Su-min's disappearance after Min-hwan's death, the fate intertwined with Ji-won finally dissolves. Ji-won receives a formal invitation to Chairman Yu Han-il's home and starts planning her future with Ji-hyuk. Just as they are about to attain their happiness, Su-min reappears to conclude the long-forged tragic fate.

Entries.Title: Lovely Runner
Entries.Description: Right after Ryu Sun-jae, a top star, ends his life, Im Sol, his top fan, somehow ends up at a time when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally meet.

Episodes.Title: Live Another Day
Episodes.Description: Sol had gotten into an accident and had no will to live a life. However, a phone call from Sun-jae, the vocalist of the group Eclipse, gave her hope and comfort. Since that day, she has become Sun-jae's fan. Years have passed, and Sol goes to Sun-jae's concert. But a few hours later, Sun-jae is found dead. And then, Sol goes back to 2008, when Sun-jae was still alive.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Protect You
Episodes.Description: Sol is confused about the situation, but one thing she knows is that she must save Sun-jae. She finds out that she can't directly explain the future. To save Sun-jae, she decides to become friends with him, but it's not easy to become friends. Meanwhile, Tae-sung is curious about Sol who changed all of a sudden. And Sun-jae is also bothered by Sol who appeared in front of him from nowhere.

Episodes.Title: It’s All About the Timing
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae wins the gold medal at the competition and he decides to confess his feelings for Sol. But due to unexpected events, it’s not as easy as it seemed. Sol thinks that she has changed the future, but Sun Jae gets hurt during practice. Sun-jae decides to quit swimming and it makes Sol heartbroken. Sol tries to comfort Sun-jae and Sun-jae finally confesses his feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: I’m Back
Episodes.Description: Sol is back in 2023. She couldn't save Sun-jae, but she found out that she did make some changes in the past. She manages to go back in time again, but things have turned out strangely while she was gone. Sol is officially dating Tae-sung and Sun-jae feels confused and betrayed about Sol. He wants to keep a distance from Sol, but Sol keeps showing up. Meanwhile, Sol gets lost on her way home.

Episodes.Title: Sun-jae Sings
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae saves Sol just in time. Sol realizes how precious her life is and tries not to miss out on many things. Tae-sung feels jealous of Sun-jae who seems close to Sol. Meanwhile, the vocalist of Tae-sung's band can't come to the band contest and Sun-jae sings for the band. Sun-jae gives the prize to Sol as a gift, but Sol is upset because he sang in a band which she wanted to prevent from happening.

Episodes.Title: I Liked It That Day
Episodes.Description: Sol breaks up with Tae-sung, thinking he only dated her to avoid the girl who likes him. Sun-jae tries to be cool with Sol so he can win her heart, but it’s not easy for him to hide his feelings. Sol tries to avoid her accident that will happen to her in the future. Meanwhile, Tae-sung gets in an accident and gets hospitalized. At the hospital, he runs into someone unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Thank You for Being Alive
Episodes.Description: Sol manages to escape from the kidnapper and Sun-jae saves him. At that moment, Sol is back in 2023. She is relieved to know that Sun-jae is safe as well, but a lot of things have changed. Her legs are fine and she works at a film production company. Hyun-joo and Geum are married and having another baby. Meanwhile, Sol goes to Sun-jae’s concert to meet him.

Episodes.Title: How About Now?
Episodes.Description: Sol and Sun-jae meet at the Hangang Bridge as they promised. Sol is worried that something might happen to Sun-jae if she lets him go. She insists they spend the night together and the two end up going to Sun-jae's place. They finally realized how they felt about each other after all those years. However, an unexpected accident happens, making Sol flustered again.

Episodes.Title: Sol Goes Back Again
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae is attacked again and he’s in a critical condition. Police disclose information on the culprit and Sol notices that the timeline has changed again. She manages to find a way to get back to the past, and this time, she goes to the same college with Sun-jae. Sol wants to keep distance from Sun-jae, but they keep run into each other. Meanwhile, Sun-jae gets a chance to get a rehabilitation training in the US.

Episodes.Title: I Figured It All Out
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae tells Sol he will leave for the US for the rehabilitation training. Sol is relieved to hear the news as he’ll be safe in the US, but she feels sad at the same time. In-hyuk asks Sun-jae to join his band and go to the audition together. Tae-sung finds out about Sol’s kidnapping case and he comes to see her. Meanwhile, Sun-jae goes to the airport to leave for the US.

Episodes.Title: Become a Couple
Episodes.Description: Sol and Sun-jae decide to be honest with their feelings and enjoy every moment together until Sol goes back to the future. Their parents find out that they are dating, and a small mistake leads to a big misunderstanding. Kim Young-soo is arrested by the police and Sol feels relieved. Meanwhile, In-hyuk's band is performing for the last time and tries to help him.

Episodes.Title: Go On a Trip
Episodes.Description: Kim Young-soo escapes and Sun-jae wants to protect Sol and make her feel relieved. They run into Geum and Hyun-joo and find out about their relationship. In-hyuk goes back to his home in the countryside as he quits the band. Sun-jae, Sol, and Tae-sung go to In-hyuk’s place to tell him that Eclipse might have a chance to debut. Meanwhile, Sol notices that the future has changed.

Episodes.Title: My Future Has Changed
Episodes.Description: Sol lies to Sun-jae and leaves him. Sun-jae comes back to Seoul alone, but he finds out that Sol lied to him. He goes back to find her, but Sol doesn't answer his calls. Meanwhile, Sol asks Detective Kim to help her catch Kim Young-soo. Since she knows when and where the incident will happen, she sets a trap to get him at once. However, the incident brings an unexpected result.

Episodes.Title: The Wrong Script
Episodes.Description: After Sun-jae and Sol's brief and misunderstood encounter at the award ceremony, Sun-jae is accidentally given the wrong script proposed by Sol. However, upon reading it, Sun-jae becomes inexplicably determined to play a role in it while Sol tries her best not to get mixed up with him. But as things don't go the way she wants them to, Sol even thinks about quitting her job.

Episodes.Title: Memories Don't Disappear
Episodes.Description: Sol passes out on the Ferris Wheel and Sun-jae takes her to his place and looks after her. Sol wants to draw a line, but Sun Jae can’t stop having feelings for her. He keeps seeing visions when he’s with Sol, and he wants to know about it. Sun-jae joins Sol’s movie, but on the day of the meeting, he finds out that Sol quit her job. Meanwhile, Tae-sung finds Kim Young-soo.

Episodes.Title: I Remember Everything
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae's memory comes back and now he remembers everything that happened between Sol and him. Thanks to Tae-sung, the ill-fated relations are resolved and the couple can be together. Sun-jae wants to propose to Sol, but finding the right time is difficult. Sun-ae decides to attend Sol’s nephew’s first birthday party and meet Sol’s family.

Entries.Title: Love Next Door
Entries.Description: A woman attempting to reboot her life returns to Korea and becomes entangled with her childhood friend — with whom she shares a complicated history.

Episodes.Title: Comeback
Episodes.Description: Soon-to-be-wed Bae Seok-ryu returns to Korea and runs into her old friend Choi Seung-hyo. But she acts strangely around him, hiding a secret.

Episodes.Title: Hate
Episodes.Description: Even as her loved ones ask for an explanation, Seok-ryu hides her vulnerabilities until a confrontation with her mom forces Seung-hyo to come to her aid.

Episodes.Title: Stop Line
Episodes.Description: As Seok-ryu adjusts to unemployment, she faces anxiety about her stagnant life. Seung-hyo clashes with his partner after a tense business meeting.

Episodes.Title: Past Perfect
Episodes.Description: When Seok-ryu's old company presents a promising opportunity, she and Seung-hyo collaborate. Later, an unsettling encounter leaves Seok-ryu rattled.

Episodes.Title: Go Back
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo starts acting awkwardly around Seok-ryu as old feelings resurface. To complicate things further, he faces a delicate situation at work.

Episodes.Title: Your First
Episodes.Description: Seok-ryu explores a new career path, tapping into a childhood passion. However, her family faces a crisis when her father's secret comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Love is All About Timing
Episodes.Description: A figure from Seok-ryu's past appears, leaving those around her looking for clarity — including Seung-hyo, who navigates his own complicated feelings.

Episodes.Title: His Secret
Episodes.Description: As the truth finally comes out, Seung-hyo waits for Seok-ryu's response. Meanwhile, Seok-ryu's parents discover her new endeavor, sparking their fury.

Episodes.Title: Darkness in Life
Episodes.Description: As Seok-ryu deals with an ailment, Seung-hyo and Song Hyeon-jun compete for her affection. But soon, Seung-hyo discovers the real reason for her return.

Episodes.Title: Bear in the Cave
Episodes.Description: Seok-ryu's secret comes to light, leaving her loved ones struggling with the shock. When she goes missing, Seung-hyo desperately sets out to find her.

Episodes.Title: Belated
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo awaits Seok-ryu's genuine response as time passes since his confession. But suddenly, he receives a shocking announcement from his parents.

Episodes.Title: Puppy Love
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu try to navigate their relationship dynamic. Soon, feelings of jealousy arise, and they struggle to resolve a fight.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: As their relationship blooms, Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu struggle to keep their status a secret. Jung Mo-eum finds out what's behind Kang Dan-ho's coldness.

Episodes.Title: Sweet Love
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo takes it into his own hands to encourage Seok-ryu's cooking ambitions. Convinced it's the right moment, he asks her an important question.

Episodes.Title: Bravo, My Life
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu face their parents' wrath after their secret is revealed — pushing the tension between their mothers to a boiling point.

Episodes.Title: The End
Episodes.Description: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu, happy in their relationship, prepare for a lifetime together. They inspire each other as they work toward their personal goals.

Entries.Title: Pyramid Game
Entries.Description: Every last Thursday of the month at an all-girls high school, the students of Class 2–5 cast their votes in a popularity poll. The results classify them into Grades A, B, C, D, and F. If they fall into Grade F, they become legitimate victims of school violence.

Episodes.Title: Sung Soo Ji: The Transfer Student
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji transfers to Baekyeon Girls’ High School and discovers that her class plays a game called the Pyramid Game in which the students decide on a hierarchy based on a popular vote. As Soo Ji ends up in the lowest rank, she devises a plan to get back on her feet.

Episodes.Title: The Mastermind of the Pyramid Game
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji is determined to figure out the characteristics of her classmates and the mastermind behind the Pyramid Game. She also tries to join forces with other girls who seem vulnerable. She even asks her homeroom teacher for help, only to be disappointed. Meanwhile, the 14th Pyramid Game begins, and Ja Eun, who kept skipping school, shows up.

Episodes.Title: The Birth of a Trio
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji moves up to Grade C, and the treatment she gets changed completely overnight. She breaks the promise she made with Ja Eun, but she decides to join hands with her and help the new girl in Grade F, Pyo Ji Ae. Soo Ji, Ja Eun, and Ji Ae come up with a plan to destroy the pyramid altogether.

Episodes.Title: The Leaked Plan
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji begins to feel uneasy about the unfolding events, suspecting that her plan may have been compromised and that Ha Rin is catching on. Learning this, Pyo Ji Ae worries she may have made a mistake and dreads the potential consequences. Meanwhile, Soo Ji hints to Hae Jun that she holds leverage over her, coercing Hae Jun into assisting her. Soo Ji recruits a hacker to join her team.

Episodes.Title: Parent Observation Day
Episodes.Description: During the parents' visit to the school, Soo Ji gets caught up in Ha Rin's trap. While Soo Ji tries to make a pact with Do Ah,  Seung Yi puts on a show to put Soo Ji on the spot. Although the parents witness the ordeal, Ha Rin turns the situation to her advantage and even has her grandmother, the chairwoman of Baekyeon Group. Meanwhile, Soo Ji switches to her Plan B.

Episodes.Title: Tables Turned
Episodes.Description: With no Grade F in the 15th game, Soo Ji changes gears to eliminate the game with Ye Lim's help. First, she suggests voting to revoke Grade A privileges and puts Ha Rin on the spot. Meanwhile, Ha Rin doesn't give in to Soo Ji's hindrances and thinks of a plan to demolish Soo Ji's game.

Episodes.Title: Shattering Friendship
Episodes.Description: Baekyeon Girls’ High School goes on a school retreat. While practicing diving, someone pushes Ha Rin into the water, and Ja Yeon jumps in to save her. The next day, Class Five plays a survival game using paint guns. The last five standing, Soo Ji, Ja Eun, Jae Hyung, Eun Jung, and Ji Ae are put in danger of ending up in Grade F.

Episodes.Title: The Majority
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji decides to recruit more girls to end the game and Ha Rin for good. When Da Yeon is about to be punished for what she did to Eun Jung, their teacher tells everyone that Da Yeon has to transfer to another school. Meanwhile, right before the Pyramid Game is held, Ye Lim gets taken to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Final Vote
Episodes.Description: The 16th Pyramid Game begins, and Ha Rin suggests choosing a classmate who will become a permanent Grade F. Before the voting takes place, Soo Ji tells the class that Ye Lim was attacked and hospitalized. The class decides to vote on whether to stay. playing or not, and the entire process is broadcast live, causing the school to be in an uproar. Meanwhile, Ja Eun tells Soo Ji what she did to Ha Rin when they were little.

Episodes.Title: The Verdict
Episodes.Description: Ja Eun reveals what she used to do to Ha Rin, but Soo Ji thinks Ha Rin is just using it as an excuse to make Ja Eun's life miserable. The school and Baekyeon Group decide to blame Soo Ji and her group for the violence at school, but Ms. Yoon Na Hee takes action and reveals the video of Soo Ji being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ji reveals the corruption behind the teacher recruitment.

Entries.Title: Queen of Tears
Entries.Description: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis—until love miraculously begins to bloom again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After Hae-in reveals her grim news to Hyun-woo, he begins to treat her nicely. Meanwhile, Hae-in's old classmate returns to Korea and joins Queens Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo discovers troubling evidence after saving Hae-in from a boar attack. Meanwhile, the two slowly find their long-lost feelings reigniting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As Yoon Eun-sung increasingly interlopes in Hae-in's life, Hyun-woo begins to feel jealous. Hae-in later shows up for Baek Du-gwan in his time of need.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Hyun-woo and Hae-in spend time in his hometown, they awkwardly navigate their complex feelings. Hae-in later receives bad news about her diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo unexpectedly shows up in Berlin to secure a treatment for Hae-in. Meanwhile in Korea, Hong Man-dae faces a crisis at his company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Feeling betrayed by Hyun-woo, Hae-in pushes him away and becomes cold. Back in Korea, Hyun-woo begins to unravel a scheme against Hae-in's family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Despite being in a tense situation with Hae-in, Hyun-woo remains firm about staying in the company as his suspicions towards Eun-sung grow even stronger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hae-in and her family go into hiding in Hyun-woo's hometown to figure out their next move. Eun-sung discovers the truth about Hae-in's health.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Eun-sung tracks down Hae-in, presenting her with an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo skillfully uses leverage to get Grace Ko on the Hong family's side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Hae-in makes a shocking announcement at a press conference. Hyun-woo launches a risky evidence-collecting crusade to save Queens Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hae-in's symptoms worsen as she suffers from hallucinations, which Eun-sung takes advantage of. Soon after, Hyun-woo finds himself captured and in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The Hong family initiates a counterattack against Seul-hee and Eun-sung. Hyun-woo and Hae-in get to experience a freshly renewed life as 'newlyweds.'

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After Hae-in shows hesitation about the surgery, her loved ones try to persuade her. Meanwhile, Eun-sung heads to Germany with a sinister plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: As Hae-in recovers from surgery, Eun-sung tries to stay right by her side. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo searches for evidence to vindicate himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Eun-sung executes his final plan to make Hae-in his own. As she tries to escape from his grasp with the help of Hyun-woo, will they finally find peace?

Entries.Title: Family by Choice
Entries.Description: A youth romance about two men and woman who aren't blood related but treated each other as family during their teens and how they meet again after 10 years.

Episodes.Title: Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon Meet
Episodes.Description: A family of three moves into the Oryun Mansion Complex, and Ju-won meets San-ha, the brother she always wanted, for the first time. Despite Ju-won's eager wish to get to know him, San-ha has trouble accepting her due to his family's situation. Meanwhile, San-ha's father meets Kang Seo-hyun, a single mother with a son named Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: One Family Name
Episodes.Description: After growing up together as a family, Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon go to high school together. San-ha and Hae-joon are hot with the girls, causing Ju-won to deal with the onslaught of requests from the girls to deliver their love message to them. Meanwhile, Ju-won longs to live under one family name through adoption, which the others think is absurd. Later, Hae-joon catches a suspicious man taking photos of him.

Episodes.Title: Two Fathers
Episodes.Description: A man visits Hae-joon at school and reveals that he is Hae-joon's birth father. Although Hae-joon is initially speechless, he feels relieved to learn that his father has not abandoned him. To find out more about his father, he and San-ha talk with Aunt Yi-hyun to gain insight into his father's character before meeting him in person and uncovering the reasons for his sudden return after all these years.

Episodes.Title: An Unwelcome Visitor
Episodes.Description: Ju-won feels exhilarated about going on a date with a boy who is good-looking and smart, but she soon gets disappointed by what he says to her. San-ha and his father are upset by an unwelcome visitor who reminds San-ha of memories he doesn’t want to recall. A surprise present from Hae-joon’s biological father brings about a conflict between Hae-joon and his colleague.

Episodes.Title: Hae-joon’s Birthday
Episodes.Description: With Hae-joon’s birthday around the corner, San-ha and Hae-joon get into a big fight. To help them reconcile, Ju-won plans to take them to a rail bike. However, many misunderstandings develop as Ju-won collapses from a cold, and rumours between Dal and Hae-joon spread at the school. Meanwhile, everyone gets ready as Yi-hyun plans to join the birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Visit from Hae-joon’s Mom
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon’s mother, Seo-hyun, unexpectedly visits Yoon’s Kalguksu to repay her debt, leaving Jung Jae puzzled as to what to do with it. Meanwhile, So-hee goes missing after leaving home to meet San-ha. Her disappearance reignites the unresolved conflict between Moo-sung and Jeong-hee, resulting in San-ha's decision to distance himself from the family.

Episodes.Title: The Basketball Game
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that his mother had come to pay back her debt, but did not stay long enough to see him. After CSAT, misunderstandings between San-ha, Ju-won, Hae-joon, and Dal build up as they are clueless about each other’s true feelings. Meanwhile, Hae-joon’s birth father watches his son’s basketball game and suggests he study further in the US.

Episodes.Title: Leaving the Countryside
Episodes.Description: San-ha stays in Seoul to look after his step-sister while his mother recovers from surgery. Ju-won goes to Seoul alone to surprise him without telling the rest of the family. Meanwhile back at home, Jeong-jae collapses from overworking, scaring everyone, especially Hae-joon, who makes up his mind about going to the US.

Episodes.Title: A Decade Later
Episodes.Description: Ju-won is shocked to find out both San-ha and Hae-joon have made up their mind to leave for Seoul and the US. Feeling a part of the family will be missing, she can’t help but cry. Jeong -jae also feels bad sending the boys away and feels empty in heart. Ten years passed, San-ha and Hae-joon came back as two grown-ups.

Episodes.Title: Awkward Reunion
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Hae-joon come back on Ju-won’s birthday after ten years. Though they haven’t seen each other for years, unlike what Ju-won had imagined, she feels indifferent about their return and is not happy to see them. Meanwhile, the family finds out a shocking truth about Hae-joon at Ju-won’s birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: San-ha’s Confession
Episodes.Description: San-ha’s sudden confession startles Ju-won. While she tries to deny any romance between them and stay as siblings, she is overcome with mixed feelings. Hae-joon jokingly suggests getting married to Ju-won, upsetting San-ha. Meanwhile, a surprise visit from Seo-hyun shocks Jeong-jae as an unexpected turn of events takes place.

Episodes.Title: A New Start
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Ju-won finally confirm their feelings for one another. However, they soon become worried about how to break the news to their family and friends. Meanwhile, Hae-joon tries to pay back Jeong-jae for everything he has done for him, but some misunderstandings develop as Hae-joon’s source of money is revealed.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Having Insomnia
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that San-ha is struggling with insomnia and taking medication. So-hui comes to visit San-ha alone without telling Jeong-hee and asks him to stay with her and Jeong-hee. Dal keeps trying to hide her feelings for Hae-joon. Meanwhile, a big secret between Ju-won and San-ha is about to be revealed by none other than Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: Unchosen, Unloved, Alone
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon is filled with a deep sense of betrayal as he watches San-ha and Ju-won on the verge of kissing, struggling to understand how Ju-won could accept San-ha as a boyfriend. He’s haunted by the fear that, like everyone else before them, they too will eventually leave him. Meanwhile, though he knows where his mother is, Hae-joon watches her from a distance, and each glimpse only fuels his growing hatred for her.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Getting Hurt
Episodes.Description: Everyone is happy with San-ha and Ju-won dating, except one person. San Ha gets hurt and rushed to the emergency room and even Jeong-jae and Dae-uk hurriedly come to check on him. Hae-joon decides to play basketball again. Dal is deeply disappointed and devastated. Meanwhile, when Ju-won is alone at her bakery, an unwelcome visitor comes to see her.

Episodes.Title: Someone for Everyone
Episodes.Description: San-ha can't wait any longer. He approaches Jeong-jae and requests his approval to be with Ju-won. Ju-won and Hae-joon try to work some romantic magic between Jeong-jae and Seo-hyun while Dal goes on a blind date, as suggested by Jae-eun. However, Hae-joon doesn't like the idea and doesn't let his chance go. Meanwhile, Jeong-hee plans to move to the UK with So-hee.

Entries.Title: A Killer Paradox
Entries.Description: When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan-gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A mysterious woman approaches Tang, claiming to know his secret and begins to blackmail him. The weight of his actions starts taking a mental toll.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Nan-gam struggles to find clear answers as he investigates the latest deaths. After connecting with an enigmatic figure, Tang decides to turn himself in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Wondering if the same killer is behind all the murders, Nan-gam probes Roh Bin for clues, leading to an unlikely partnership between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Nan-gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In his search for Tang, Song Chon confronts Bin — who desperately turns to Nan-gam for help. But Tang agrees to meet with Chon, who has a proposition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Nan-gam comes face to face with Chon, who recognizes him from the past. As Bin and Tang plan their final escape, Bin receives a menacing phone call.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The endgame to the chase leads to a final fight — and it's everyone versus Chon. In the process, Nan-gam finally learns the truth about his father.

Entries.Title: High School Return of a Gangster
Entries.Description: A spirit of a middle school dropout gangster who accidentally possesses an 18-year-old boy’s body who killed himself, goes back to high school to take a revenge against the bullies with his gangster skills and encounters unexpected relationship.

Episodes.Title: Deuk Pal Goes to High School
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal is about to become the boss of the Chilsung Gang. While mulling over giving up his dream of going to university, he tries to save Yi Heon from jumping off a bridge. Unfortunately, Deuk Pal loses his life but takes over Yi Heon's body. He learns of Yi Heon's misfortunes and resolves to avenge his suffering as a victim of bullying.

Episodes.Title: You Are Not Song Yi Heon
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal, now inhabiting Yi Heon’s body, arouses suspicion from Se Kyung due to his noticeable deviation from his usual self. Despite Deuk Pal's attempts to mimic Yi Heon's behaviour, the other kids begin to question the sudden change in him. Particularly with Jae Min persisting in ridiculing Yi Heon, Deuk Pal plots a subtle revenge for him.

Episodes.Title: Deuk Pal Takes Charge
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal proves he can fight in Yi Heon's body and gains control over Jae Min and his underlings. The kids at school can't believe how different Yi Heon is and are shocked. Se Kyung gets DNA testing done to see if Yi Heon is still the Yi Heon he knows, and Deuk Pal focuses on his studies and setting things right for Yi Heon. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal learns about what happened the night before Yi Heon died from Se Kyung as they become closer.

Episodes.Title: Yi Heon's Mom Kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung save Yi Heon's mom from getting kidnapped. Luckily, she was unharmed. Although he has a hunch about who might be responsible, Deuk Pal vows to protect Yi Heon and his family without the police involved. Meanwhile, Jae Min approaches Deuk Pal to find out if the police are looking for him, but Se Kyung confronts him about his involvement in the attempted kidnapping.

Episodes.Title: Yi Heon Warns Dong Soo
Episodes.Description: Se Kyung witnesses Yi Heon getting abducted but can't do anything about it because he remembers Yi Heon telling him not to call the police about anything. He asks Jae Min for help, but Jae Min cowards out. Meanwhile, Yi Heon deals with the gangsters and tells them things that shock them.

Episodes.Title: Reach Out
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung go to see the ocean and have a day off. Se Kyung talks about his father who’s been trying to control him since young and how it made him stressed and suffocating. Se Kyung’s father comes to school and calls for the violence committee. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal finds out that Yi Heon’s mother has been taking addictive medicine.

Episodes.Title: This Is Your Last Chance
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal found out that the school bullies reported Yi Heon for school violence. He orders Dong Soo and the gang to get Lee Mi Kyung since she is the one behind them. Byung Chul tells Jae Min to join him and report Yi Heon as well. Jae Min feels guilty about falsely charging Yi Heon, but he's also scared that he might end up going to the juvie if the truth is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Jae Min confesses to bullying Yi Heon and other kids at school. Thanks to Jae Min, the charges are dropped, but Deuk Pal still needs to find Mi Kyung so that she won't come back to threaten Yi Heon and his mother again. He decides to meet Chairman Bae and set everything right. Meanwhile, Yi Heon's soul returns and tells Deuk Pal that he does not have much time left.

Entries.Title: A Shop for Killers
Entries.Description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

Episodes.Title: Murthehelp
Episodes.Description: Ji-an, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

Episodes.Title: Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man
Episodes.Description: Jin-man receives an unexpected call; Ji-an, who is alone at home, is pursued by unidentified men.

Episodes.Title: The Strong Don't Howl
Episodes.Description: Ji-an finds herself in danger as she searches for a rescue phone in the mountains to save Jin-man.

Episodes.Title: The Shopping Mall
Episodes.Description: Ji-an and Jeong-min flee from the killers and meet Brother in the underground shopping mall.

Episodes.Title: Babylon
Episodes.Description: Ji-an gets angry as she watches Jin-man on the screen, and Jeong-min points a gun at Ji-an's head.

Episodes.Title: Jeong Jin-man
Episodes.Description: Jin-man, who was once a mercenary of a large company, Babylon, suffers from the truth he learns.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Bale, who was presumed to be dead, begins his revenge, and Jin-man fights back to protect Ji-an.

Episodes.Title: Listen Up, Ji-an
Episodes.Description:
Killers close in on Jin-man's house. Ji-an prepares for the final duel on her own.

Season Finale

Entries.Title: No Gain No Love
Entries.Description: Son Hae-yeong seeks out a fake wedding with her neighbourhood convenience store employee, Kim Ji-uk, to avoid missing out on a promotion.

Episodes.Title: EP1
Episodes.Description: Son Hae-yeong, a woman who is calculating by nature and hates to suffer losses. Kim Ji-uk, a civilian officer, neighborhood angel, perfect convenience store part-timer who hates causing trouble to people. After breaking up with her boyfriend to avoid losses, Hae-yeong makes a surprising offer to Ji-uk to win the in-house contest. What offer could she have made?

Episodes.Title: EP2
Episodes.Description: Strange behavior follows after the proposal. Ji-uk rejects Hae-yeong's offer to be her fake husband without hesitation. Woo-jae shamelessly gaslights Hae-yeong after stealing her idea. Provoked by Woo-jae, Hae-yeong becomes increasingly desperate for a fake marriage and starts searching for a husband on a secondhand app. Will she find a fake husband?

Episodes.Title: EP3
Episodes.Description: This marriage is a failure! Shocked by Ji-uk's true looks, Hae-yeong vents her frustrations and becomes suspicious of him for knowing so much about her. Rumors about her handsome husband spark her coworkers' curiosity about her proposal story. Hae-yeong asks Ji-uk to propose to her, only to be treated like a weirdo again. Hae-yeong's wedding plan to erase all memories of her husband begins!

Episodes.Title: EP4
Episodes.Description: What are the odds of staying at the same hotel as your ex on your wedding day? Thanks to Woo-jae and Yi-lin, Hae-yeong and Ji-uk spend the night together. She teases him about his inexperience, and he mentions their kiss. They spend the night discussing gains and losses. Hae-yeong goes on the honeymoon alone while Ji-uk disappears without a word. Hae-yeong spots Ji-uk at an unexpected place!

Episodes.Title: EP5
Episodes.Description: The husband who had been missing and out of contact shows. And as a new recruit, no less. Hae-yeong is shocked to see Ji-uk as a new recruit at Kkulbee. Though he is apologetic, he is unable to share why he had to join the company. Meanwhile, fearing that their fake marriage will be exposed, Hae-yeong devises a plan to get rid of Ji-uk. However, this unexpectedly puts her in a tough spot.

Episodes.Title: EP6
Episodes.Description: Due to Ji-uk's unpredicted disclosure of his identity, he and Hae-yeong become the talk of the company. Hae-yeong is mistaken for pulling strings to get Ji-uk employed, while Ji-uk is upset that Hae-yeong speculates him to be the one who reported her for workplace harassment. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind Ji-uk's employment slowly becomes known. Will the true nepo baby's identity be revealed?

Episodes.Title: EP7
Episodes.Description: Waking up in the same bed as your ex-boyfriend and husband? Hae-yeong and Ji-uk wake up with no memory of the previous night after getting drunk. Woo-jae is upset at Yi-lin over a sudden personnel transfer, while Hae-yeong regrets getting married, prompting Ji-uk to offer a divorce. Meanwhile, Ja-yeon, worried about Gyu-hyun, visits the orphanage and almost runs into Ha-jun.

Episodes.Title: EP8
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk's long-awaited first kiss leads to a fight. What's the meaning behind Hae-yeong's kiss and Ji-uk's kiss? Ji-uk thinks of different ways to reconcile with the angry Hae-yeong. Who will emerge victorious in their first marital fight? Meanwhile, Hae-yeong visits the orphanage with the new business idea proposed by Ji-uk and faces the risk of Woo-jae discovering her secret.

Episodes.Title: EP9
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk reconcile. Ji-uk's place turns into chaos when Gyu-hyun visits him upon learning of his secret. Ji-uk decides to quit, only to be informed of an unexpected personnel change before he can hand in his resignation letter. However, Gyu-hyun's payback doesn't end there. Hae-yeong is bound to face losses in the fight between Gyu-hyun and his father. Will she fight back or back down?

Episodes.Title: EP10
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong is shocked by Gyu-hyun's sudden appearance and Ja-yeon's confession. Gyu-hyun reveals Ji-uk and Ja-yeon's secrets, making Hae-yeong furious and driving them out of the house. Now homeless and uncertain, Ji-uk receives advice from Mr. Jang to live on his own terms. Ji-uk, the angel who has always lived for others, and Hae-yeong, who has discovered his secret. What will be their fate?

Episodes.Title: EP11
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong storms out of the house after finding out about Ji-uk's secret, and Ji-uk is unable to hold her back. Ja-yeon feels heavy-hearted, thinking that Hae-yeong is angry because of her. Gyu-hyun and Ji-uk are equally shocked upon learning Hae-yeong and Ja-yeon's secret. Ji-uk struggles to find Hae-yeong, whose whereabouts are unknown, while Hae-yeong is clouded. Will he find her?

Episodes.Title: EP12
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong is heartbroken over Eun-ok's sudden death. As she bids farewell with the help of her foster siblings, she begins to understand Eun-ok's life. Meanwhile, she feels heavy-hearted as Ji-uk promises not to leave her. Hae-yeong wishes for Ji-uk to live freely, while Ji-uk struggles to understand her. What will become of their complicated relationship?

Entries.Title: My Merry Marriage
Entries.Description:
A delightful family drama that asks the true meaning of 'happiness' by showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and single life, and brings about empathy and laughter from all generations.

Maeng Gong Hee is a contract designer at Jayce Fashion. Having inherited her strong mother's spirit and her former detective father's athletic ability, she is a rare wild woman these days who has the guts to survive even if she were to be stranded on a deserted island.

Gu Dan Soo is the grandson of Jayce Fashion Chairman Hwang Ik Seon and born to a wealthy father and a poor mother. Dan Soo, who was living as a free spirit in a foreign country, comes to Korea according to his grandmother's plan to make a successor to the chairman out of him and he reunites with childhood friend Maeng Gong Hee once again.

Entries.Title: Snow White's Revenge
Entries.Description: Jeong In is found dead, grasping a note forewarning her death. In the past, she and Min Tae Chang conspired and killed Baek Seol Ah's father and stole his fortune. After using the money she stole to become the CEO of a production company she found, she meets and falls for Seo Jin Ho, an aspiring actor who looks just like her first love. Jeong In transforms him into Jung Woo Jin, a top star. However, she learns that his former love is Baek Seol Ah and that Park Jin Kyung, the unrevealed writer of "Poker Face," is the same person as Baek Seol Ah. Baek Seol Ah vows to get revenge after learning that her ex-boyfriend, Seo Jin Ho, is involved with Jeong In, who had murdered her father. She resolves to write a drama to complete her revenge. Could Baek Seol Ah be Moon Jeong In's murderer? The culprit was someone in the banquet hall, but everyone wished for Jeong In's death. Who was it, and for what reason did they kill her?

Entries.Title: The Judge from Hell
Entries.Description: A cruel and vicious judge, who wields power only for herself, meets a warm and cheerful detective who puts the victims first.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Demon Justitia possesses the body of Judge Kang Bit-na and must punish criminals.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Da-on receives unexpected news while protecting Min-jeong. Bitn-a's first infernal trial begins.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While reveling in her string of executions, Bit-na encounters someone unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Bit-na’s infernal trial begins once again for Bae Jayeong’s misdeeds. “Bad adults must be punished.”

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: While trailing Bi-tna, Da-on finds himself at a secret demons’ meeting. A horrific incident occurs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: “Why do you keep interfering?” Will Bit-na escape Da-on and conclude her infernal trial?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: So-young suspects serial killer J is back. Meanwhile, Da-on remains suspicious about Bit-na’s identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: So-young disappears. Bit-na worries for Da-on but concludes Choi Won-joong’s infernal trial as a demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Da-on vows revenge against serial killer J and joins forces with demon Bit-na.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Detective J’s true identity is uncovered. Bit-na encounters emotions she’s never wanted to face.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Bit-na loses her powers for breaking the rules but still heads to Jae-geol’s home to uncover J.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A body is found in a burned car, and the truth is revealed. Who is J?

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Finally, J’s trial begins. At a crossroads, Bit-na must make a life-or-death choice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: J commits another evil act after escaping, and Bit-na is dragged to Hell. Will this be the end?

Entries.Title: When the Phone Rings
Entries.Description: A rising politician and his mute wife's tense marriage begins to unravel after a call from a kidnapper turns their lives upside down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After receiving a call from Hong Hee-joo's kidnapper, Paik Sa-eon attempts to learn more about him — only to find it's hard to escape his surveillance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon works quickly to track down the caller, forcing Hee-joo to stay hypervigilant. Despite her fears, she continues to play along with the ruse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After Sa-eon experiences an attack, he grows wary of Hee-joo's relationship with her friend. Meanwhile, an ominous figure makes his presence known.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After receiving the ominous call, Hee-joo abandons her clandestine plan. She then undergoes a tough interview with Sa-eon — sharing an intimate moment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon grapples with feelings of betrayal after learning the truth about Hee-joo. However, when she receives good news, they begin to grow fonder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hee-joo confronts a figure from her past who wishes to reveal what she knows. She then embarks on a retreat with Sa-eon — who becomes possessive of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon and Hee-joo's relationship shifts after her harrowing rescue. Determined to catch the kidnapper, Sa-eon goes full force — with the help of 406.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Hee-joo and Sa-eon grow closer, the threat from the kidnapper intensifies. Sa-eon discovers an ominous and shocking clue from a past figure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hee-joo worries about Sa-eon after learning the truth about him. She later appears on the stage of her dreams, side by side with her love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: While attempting to rescue Hee-joo, Sa-eon discovers another surprising conspirator — whom he later tries to persuade to help locate the kidnapper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After Hee-joo's bold move, her fate and that of her kidnapper remain uncertain. But Sa-eon refuses to give up — leaving no stone unturned to find her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon abandons everything he's worked for, leaving Hee-joo completely alone. But after a clue arrives, she embarks on a journey to reunite with him.

Entries.Title: Mr. Plankton
Entries.Description: A man plagued by misfortune and his ex, the unluckiest bride-to-be, are forced to accompany one another on the final journey of his life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo, who runs an errand center, accepts Noh Yang-hui's request to kidnap her on her wedding day. Later, he unexpectedly runs into an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo sets out to find his sperm donor, the biological father he never knew. He crashes Jo Jae-mi's wedding and drags her along.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo recounts his first meeting with Jae-mi. While a huge fight breaks out at the sundae shop, Eo Heung and Wang Chil-seong's gang close in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jae-mi makes a tough choice between Hae Jo and her devoted fiancé. Soon they head down to Busan, while a mysterious figure arrives to bail Heung out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo spends meaningful time with Ko Jae-geun up in the mountains. Back in Seoul, Chil-seong corners Kkari and forces him to track down his old partner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Heung reflects on his relationship with Jae-mi. After Hae Jo steals a boat to escape Chil-seong, they end up stranded on a deserted island.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Shaken by the island ordeal, Hae Jo slips into a slump his friend Yang Bong-suk can't lift. Meanwhile, Heung does everything to stay by Jae-mi's side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Afraid of hurting Jae-mi again, Hae Jo tries to push her away. Later, he takes on a new errand and meets a young girl looking for her long-lost brother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After learning about Hae Jo's severe condition, Jae-mi is determined to help him find his biological father. But when she returns, he's gone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Now alone with Heung, Hae Jo reflects on his unfortunate life. After a tense reunion at Kkari's workplace, Hae Jo decides to confront his painful past.

Entries.Title: The 8 Show
Entries.Description: Eight individuals trapped in a mysterious 8-story building participate in a tempting but dangerous show where they earn money as time passes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Badly in debt, a man hesitantly joins a mysterious show and meets seven other eclectic strangers. Their first goal? Figure out the rules.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Realizing that an activity rewards them with time, the eight coordinate a plan. But soon, chaos erupts as their strategy doesn't last.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A participant approaches 3rd Floor with a proposal to steer the next activity selection. After, a strategic vote takes place to pick the bathroom location.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: One participant establishes rank on the others, making them desperate. Soon, a new game of dares begins — and a savage hand-to-hand fight ensues.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A few floors strategically band together to get an upper hand on the others. But the victims see their salvation in a potential uprising.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Now with the tables turned to their favor, the lower floors plan their endgame. However, the clock keeps winding up as strange, brutal events unfold.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: An act of altruism backfires, putting some participants in danger. But a shocking move changes everything — switching the dynamic up once again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: One participant suggests an idea to turn the tides back in their favor. But the show falls into disarray when the result turns out duplicitous.

Entries.Title: Flex x Cop
Entries.Description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Jin Isoo, the naïve heir of Hansu Group, gets into a fight with a stranger and Ganghyun arrests him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A model is found dead on a yacht. Isoo gets his first murder case and investigates with Ganghyun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The team finds the key suspect in the model murder case. However, other suspects come to light.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A famous painter has been murdered in an art gallery. Meanwhile, Yi Soo visits his childhood home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yi Soo captures the prime suspect in the painter's case, and he learns something unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The death of an elderly is all but simple. Kang Hyun works to prove it, and Yi Soo seeks other methods.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: A bizarre body is found in an office. Isoo and Ganghyun start investigating the mysterious death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: A man is caught at the suspect's house. Isoo investigates the link between the found item and death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Isoo recovers memories with hypnosis and looks for Myeongchul. Meanwhile, an actress is found dead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Isoo and Ganghyun discover the actress had a stalker and was harassed by him before her death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The sudden death of two people affiliated with Oryunhoe. Ganghyun tries to uncover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Isoo encounters Ganghyun at Oryunhoe, and they face a crisis of being exposed to the cult leader.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: An unknown body is found in Myeongchul's backyard amidst the election. Isoo investigates the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: The team arrests the suspect in the case. Meanwhile, Isoo discovers secrets within the household.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Truths start to unfold about his mother's death. Isoo is confronted with an unbearable reality.

Entries.Title: Light Shop
Entries.Description: In a mysterious shop that sells lamps, the dead may return to the world of the living, while the living may not walk out alive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1: Strangers
Episodes.Description: A man is curious about a woman sitting at a bus stop every night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2: The Door
Episodes.Description: A woman moves into an old house and experiences strange things. Then she faces hidden secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3: The Detective
Episodes.Description: A detective investigates the unnatural death of an old man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4: Outsiders
Episodes.Description: An undertaker and a nurse working at the same hospital face mysterious situations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5: Reunion
Episodes.Description: A bus driver gets anxious on a rainy night when things take an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6: Three-day Funeral
Episodes.Description: Will the people who tried to protect their beloved ones be able to reunite with them?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7: Afterlife
Episodes.Description: The light shop owner tells a customer the story of how he ended up in the light shop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8: Light
Episodes.Description: Youngji, who once was in a coma, brings hope and support to the patients.

Entries.Title: Doctor Slump
Entries.Description: Once rivals in school, two brilliant doctors reunite by chance — each facing life’s worst slump and unexpectedly finding solace in each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a successful career as a plastic surgeon, Yeo Jeong-woo faces a swift downfall. Nam Ha-neul collapses amid a brutal career as an anesthesiologist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo moves into a new home and runs into his old rival Ha-neul, who is his neighbor. As her well-being takes a toll, Ha-neul makes a stand at work.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When Jeong-woo's home gets broken into, Ha-neul asks him to stay at her place. After the two share a night of fun, she decides to help him in his trial.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After a trip together, Jeong-woo wonders if he was Ha-neul's first love — until she goes on a blind date. Ha-neul goes on an interview for a faraway job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo travels far to show up for Ha-neul after her interview — and several heart-to-heart moments force her to ask him how he truly feels.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A run-in with an old classmate leaves Ha-neul feeling jealous. Regardless, she gives Jeong-woo much-needed emotional support, which opens him up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: While Jeong-woo faces a mysterious attack, Ha-neul finds a crucial clue at his home. Jeong-woo encounters someone who may turn the tides of his trial.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After holding hands with Jeong-woo, Ha-neul tries to decipher their relationship status — but her mental health begins to take a toll amid sudden news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo and Ha-neul navigate life without each other after she pushes him away. Jeong-woo panics as he operates for the first time since his trial.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: As Jeong-woo struggles with his trauma, Ha-neul shows up to support him. But after he rejects her help, he discovers what made her break up with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As their love blossoms, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo struggle to keep their relationship a secret. Lee Hong-ran bonds with Bin Dae-yeong during his time of need.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: While on a nostalgic getaway, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo are joined by Hong-ran and Dae-yeong. Ha-neul confronts Min Kyung-min about a potential foul play.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo, alongside Ha-neul's family, awaits the outcome of her surgery. Later, he learns the full depth of Kyung-min's complicated motives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Needing an escape, Jeong-woo takes a special trip to Busan with Ha-neul and her family. He later laments as Ha-neul's new job takes her away from him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo tries to surprise Ha-neul with a gift, but roadblocks keep getting in his way. Soon, they begin their joint operation and complications arise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: While Jeong-woo awaits an answer from Ha-neul, she contemplates an opportunity abroad—and he anguishes over the fate of their relationship.

Entries.Title: The Two Sisters
Entries.Description: A tragic story about young sisters who part ways after their parent's divorce but reunite once again as mother and daughter-in-law in the whirlwind of fate, ending up in catastrophe after desire and conflict.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Do Eun, Yi Chul's mistress, exposes herself and their baby on her social media on purpose, and the whole world finds out about their affair. Ji Chang and Hye Won are on Soo Hyang's side for the divorce trial and try their best to comfort her. Meanwhile, Ji Chang prepares a gift for Hye Won before their wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang promises Hye Won to find her long-lost sister, Hye Ji, no matter what. Hye Won discovers Yi Chul has been embezzling company funds under a shell company for two years. Meanwhile, Do Eun is curious about Ji Chang's fiancé and wants to meet her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Do Eun plans to meet her soon-to-be daughter-in-law and rear-ends Hye Won's car to get things started. She then buys an art piece from her gallery. To learn more about the painting, Do Eun offers to have dinner together. At the dinner, Eun notices the pendant necklace around Hye Won's neck that she once shared with her biological sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Do Eun realizes Hye Won is her biological sister, whom she separated from when they were young. Meanwhile, Hye Won is confused about why Do Eun left in a rush from their dinner. Later, Hye Won learns Do Eun is Yi Chul's mistress and becomes furious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Kyung Ja appears unexpectedly and ruins Hye Won and Ji Chang's wedding while Do Eun watches from the sidelines. However, Do Eun sees Min Tae, her father, and she begins to remember the past. Meanwhile, Myung Ae can't believe the disgrace Hye Won brought to the family and scolds Ji Chang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After ruining Hye Won's wedding, Do Eun plots another scheme to bring her down with Kyung Ja. Hye Won and Ji Chang return home without going on a honeymoon, and Hye Won even sees Do Eun in her dream. While Myung Ae gives Hye Won a hard time at home, Do Eun sends a text message to Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Do Eun suggests to Hye Won that they meet and talk in person. Do Eun sends her a photo of her necklace to convince her that she is her younger sister, Hye Ji. Hye Won waits for Hye Ji at the mineral spring, but a man shows up instead of Hye Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Do Eun becomes furious after the protest in front of the Boram Childcare Facility. Do Eun suspects Hye Won is the one responsible for the protest and calls her to meet. Meanwhile, breaking news of Yi Chul's large donation to the Boram Childcare Facility by using a shell company airs, along with Do Eun's position in the facility.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is disappointed after learning that the phone number that said it was Hye Ji is from a burner phone. Meanwhile, Myung Ae visits the temple and discovers from the monk that Yi Chul will have another child of great importance, and Do Eun takes off to get some air.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After learning that Soo Hyang will be holding a talk concert, Do Eun appears at the event and asks a question during the Q and A time. Hye Won is astounded by Do Eun's appearance and tries to remedy the situation. Meanwhile, Soo Hyang realizes the woman is Do Eun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Since Young Ju and Jang Gun cannot reach Do Eun anymore, they change their target to Hye Won. To bring Hye Won down, Do Eun runs a background check on Judan Foundation for Arts and finds out about Dan Ung, who signed with the gallery. Not long after Do Eun's confrontation, another shocking news about Soo Hyang breaks out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Dan Ung frames Soo Hyang for sexual assault and disappears. No matter how hard Hye Won tries to reach him, he is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Ji Chang suspects Do Eun, so he wants to meet her in person to reveal the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang encounters Do Eun directly, only to find that she doesn't match the image of recklessness he had anticipated. Upon Ji Chang's return, Hye Won expresses her disappointment in his apparent favoring of Do Eun. Meanwhile, Soo Hyang intends to pay Attorney Song a visit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hye Won tries to find Dan Ung, who has gone out of contact, to no avail. She returns home but gets further frustrated when Ji Chang thinks the opposite about Do Eun. To make matters worse, Do Eun tells Yi Chul about what Hye Won did to her when they coincidentally met and gets Hye Won in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Ji Chang are traumatized by Yi Chul and Soo Hyang's divorce, and Ji Chang starts to resent Do Eun even more. However, Myung Ae invites Do Eun over to their place. Meanwhile, Jang Gun and Young Ju visit Hyangdan Agency to find Hye Won and run into San Deul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Do Eun meet again when Do Eun visits her in-laws at home. Do Eun shares surprising news, and Hye Won feels uncomfortable around her. The memory of their childhood unexpectedly overtakes Do Eun, but she tries to pull herself together for revenge. Meanwhile, Hye Won and Ji Chang grow apart after Do Eun joins the family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is stunned to learn that Dan Ung has departed the country, particularly shocked when she discovers his destination is Mauritius. Do Eun's fake pregnancy approaches revelation as she's guided, somewhat reluctantly, to the OB-GYN. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon establishes a law office conveniently close to San Deul’s tteokbokki spot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Do Eun uses her wits to overcome the crisis of her fake pregnancy getting exposed. Meanwhile, Hye Won searches for evidence that Do Eun was behind the incident involving Soo Hyang. She resorts to apologizing to Do Eun to get the answers she needs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Hye Won finally meets Lim Dan Ung face-to-face. After acquiring the evidence that would clear Soo Hyang's name, she hands it to Soo Hyang. However, Soo Hyang tells Hye Won that she will take care of it and calls Do Eun to meet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Now that Soo Hyang has the recorder from Dan Ung, she decides to talk to Do Eun in person. She asks Hye Won to keep it a secret from Ji Chang as she wants to handle it on her own. When Soo Hyang calls Do Eun to confront her with the evidence, Do Eun flips out and asks for forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Before Soo Hyang exposes the truth, she passes away due to a heart attack. Do Eun brazenly attends the funeral in a mourning dress, which makes Hye Won and Ji Chang infuriated. Hye Won quickly leaves the funeral after she gets a call from Dan Ung, and Do Eun tries to stop her. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon attends the funeral after hearing the news and runs into Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Hye Won heads directly to meet Lim Dan Ung, but upon arrival, she is met with a disturbing scene. Despite the confusion, Hye Won gathers her resolve to uncover the truth behind the suspicious deaths. Meanwhile, Myung Ae instructs Hye Won and Ji Chang not to conceive a child until Do Eun delivers her baby, but it may be a bit too late.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: After bumping into Hye Won at the pharmacy, Sung Yoon notices that Hye Won is pregnant. However, she doesn't recognize him and goes on her way. Meanwhile, Do Eun moves in with the family and begins to get under Hye Won's skin. Their new life under the same roof begins, but Hye Won has no intentions of giving in to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Young Ju and Min Tae run into each other and ask about their daughters, Hye Won and Hye Ji. Min Tae lies to her by saying Hye Won is studying abroad to protect Hye Won from her. Meanwhile, Do Eun lies to Ji Chang about what happened between Soo Hyang and her at the hotel, and now, she wants to set up a fake miscarriage and put the blame on Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Do Eun gets anxious after she finds out Hye Won is pregnant. Moreover, Myung Ae makes it clear to Do Eun that she will only let her join the family after she gives birth to Yi Chul's child. Therefore, instead of faking the pregnancy, Do Eun changes her plan to actually get pregnant this time. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon wants to help Hye Won with Dan Ung's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Do Eun loses her mind as her plan falls through. Now that she cannot get pregnant, her hatred for Hye Won grows even bigger and threatens her for having a baby. Hye Won and Ji Chang quarrel over Dan Ung's case, and Myung Ae orders Hye Won to retrieve Dan Ung's art pieces back from their family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang learns about Hye Won's pregnancy indirectly and reacts coldly. Hye Won tells him she didn't have the courage to tell him the news, but it doesn't work. Meanwhile, Do Eun communicates with a baby broker so that she can continue to hide her fake pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is upset at how things between Ji Chang have become regarding her pregnancy. She talks to Min Sook about it to feel better. Meanwhile, Do Eun sees San Deul talking with Hye Won and realizes he is her brother and the person who had been looking for her. She makes up her mind to get close to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Ji Chang are at odds over matters at both work and home. Ji Chang wants Hye Won to let go of Dan Ung's case, but Hye Won is not willing to give up on it. Meanwhile, now that Do Eun realizes San Deul is in love with her, she tries to make use of him to get revenge on Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Do Eun spikes the porridge San Deul got for Hye Won. Hye Won gets suspicious of the way Do Eun acts, but Ji Chang thinks she is being overly sensitive. Meanwhile, Do Eun witnesses Hye Won and Sung Yoon together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Min Tae comes to see Hye Won at her place and runs into Do Eun. When Min Tae realizes that Do Eun is his long-lost daughter, Hye Ji, Do Eun threatens him to stay quiet. Meanwhile, Hye Won asks Do Eun about what happened between Min Tae and her earlier in the day, and Do Eun shoves her as hard as she can so that she falls down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: San Deul falls for Do Eun's trap and makes reservations with Hye Won for fish porridge. She also suggests taking Sung Yoon along for the trip. Meanwhile, Do Eun brings up Sung Yoon's name with Yi Chul regarding the attorney position at the company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and the party of people headed for lunch fall into Do Eun's trap, and they all get taken to the emergency. Meanwhile, Min Tae meets Young Ju with money to keep her away from Hye Won, but Young Ju makes a scene. Just then, Min Tae's phone shows Hye Won calling that Young Ju sees.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: The whole family finds out Hye Won is pregnant, and Do Eun throws a fit at Kyung Ja as both Hye Won and her baby survived the car accident. However, Ji Chang and Hye Won's misunderstanding grows deeper after the porridge incident as Do Eun planned. Meanwhile, Min Tae worries about Hye Ji and waits for her to reach him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Hye Won figures out Do Eun is not pregnant, but she decides to stay quiet and keep an eye on her. Ji Chang straightforwardly asks Sung Yoon if he has feelings for Hye Won. Meanwhile, Hye Won runs into Young Ju at the bank.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Min Tae comes by Do Eun's place to ask for forgiveness, and Hye Won advises San Deul to stop seeing Angela. Sung Yoon and Hye Won look for Do Eun's pawn to expose her for instigating murder. Meanwhile, Ji Chang's childhood friend, Ji Eun, joins him for his next project.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Sung Yoon keeps his promise to Hye Won and tails Do Eun to find evidence. Luckily, he follows her to the OB-GYN clinic Do Eun attends and discovers her fake pregnancy. After hearing this from Sung Yoon, Hye Won takes the evidence and confronts Do Eun to make a crushing deal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: As Hye Won confronts Do Eun with her infertility diagnosis, Do Eun confesses to Hye Won that she is her sister, Hye Ji. Now that the inevitable has come, Do Eun worries anxiously about all her heinous deeds and visits Sung Yoon. Meanwhile, Ji Chang's friend Ji Eun appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Sung Yoon pressure Do Eun to find Kyung Ja, and Do Eun pays Young Ju to help her with her schemes. After Do Eun discovers that Ji Eun and Ji Chang are close friends even at work, she decides to use Ji Eun to tear Hye Won and Ji Chang apart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: After the elevator accident, Hye Won heads to her father's place to rest, and Ji Chang follows her to beg for forgiveness. Ji Chang finds out someone else sent the text message to Hye Won through Ji Eun's phone. Furthermore, Sung Yoon suspects Do Eun as the culprit behind the elevator accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: The house turns upside down as Do Eun's fake pregnancy and infertility are revealed. The whole family realizes they have been completely fooled by Do Eun, so they kick her out of their house. Do Eun ends up barging into Min Tae's place, and Hye Won lets Ji Chang know that Do Eun is her long-lost sister, Hye Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Do Eun runs away, but Hye Won notices her missing and chases up to her. Shortly after, Min Tae comes to save Do Eun but gets into a hit-and-run accident, losing his life. Draped in sorrow, Hye Won swears at Do Eun she won't stop until she takes her down. Meanwhile, Do Eun blackmails Ji Chang for money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Hye Won tells Ji Chang that she can't live with him, and Ji Chang tries to figure out how he can protect both the company and Hye Won. Meanwhile, Do Eun trembles in fear when she learns that Hye Won might get her hands on the evidence of her murder instigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Do Eun finds out Hye Won has the recorder and she is about to head to the police station to report Do Eun. Do Eun steals a delivery truck and follows Hye Won to stop her. Therefore, Hye Won ends up losing consciousness in the middle of the road.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Hye Won gets disappointed in Ji Chang again as she realizes he stopped the investigation for the car accident. However, he feigns ignorance and even gets mad at her for suspecting him. Meanwhile, Yi Chul promises Do Eun to run away together, and Myung Ae tells Hye Won to leave Ji Chang and her son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Hye Won witnesses Ji Chang having an affair with Ji Eun. Hye Won wants a divorce, but Ji Chang is not letting her leave him easily. Do Eun heads to YJ resort that's under renovation to meet Yi Chul. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon runs into Ji Chang at a memorial park and follows him to find out what he is up to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Hye Won rushes out to look for Ji Chang, but she witnesses Hye Ji get into a disastrous hit-and-run accident. Hye Ji goes in for surgery, but she falls into a coma. Meanwhile, Ji Chang goes missing, and Hye Won worries he might have to do something with Hye Ji's accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: After the autopsy, Hye Won learns that Ji Chang died from a hit-and-run accident. With that information, Hye Won and Sung Yoon search for the culprit behind Ji Chang's murder. Meanwhile, fake news about Hye Won and Sung Yoon's affair surfaces and causes mayhem for Hye Won in Ji Chang's household.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Do Eun miraculously wakes up after the car accident, but loses her memory as Do Eun. Furthermore, the doctor mentions that she also shows signs of delusion, but Hye Won is not sure if she is delusional or just lying. Five years later, Jun Mo flies back to Korea and looks forward to meeting Hye Won after a long time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Do Eun gets a part-time job as a cleaner and remembers something about Yi Chul. Even when Yi Chul is locked up in prison, he orders his assistant to keep an eye on Do Eun and waits for her to regain her memory. Meanwhile, Hye Won and Sung Yoon have a meeting with Jun Mo at Hye Won's office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: To get Jun Mo to invest in YJ Group, Sung Yoon decides to quit as Jun Mo requested. However, Hye Won tries to come up with a strategy to keep Sung Yoon by her side. Meanwhile, Ji Eun wants to bring Hye Won down through Jun Mo, and Do Eun visits Yi Chul to find out about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: Jun Mo offers Sung Yoon a chance to work together, but Sung Yoon feels his proposal is a trap. Hye Ji worries she might end up in jail and attempts to feel out Hye Won if she has the voice recording of her as evidence. Meanwhile, Yi Chul threatens Hye Won with the clause in her deal regarding her son and pushes her to get him out of prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji starts to remember things in fragments, and Hye Won looks for a way to force Hye Ji into hospitalization. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon gets his hands on a dashcam video that shows Cha Ji Eun at the scene of Ji Chang's death. Later, they track her down to get her to confess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
