Episodes.Description: Upon discovering that Capt. Concha is working with Sky, Tori instructs her spy to thwart their plans by any means necessary. The conflict between Roxy and Kevin worsens as the latter's jealousy spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: Surrender
Episodes.Description: As Tim, Gino, Capt. Concha, and Atty. Jeff help her prove her innocence, Sky turns herself in to the police. However, tension escalates when Tori suddenly shows up at the precinct with alleged witnesses.

Episodes.Title: Dismissed
Episodes.Description: Things work out in Sky's favor as Tori's complaint against her gets dismissed. Roxy finally ends things with Kevin after another emotional confrontation. Later, Sky's family and friends gather to celebrate her win.

Episodes.Title: Guilty
Episodes.Description: Tim's heart shatters into pieces after Poch rejects his attempt to reconcile. A heated confrontation ensues between Sky and tori as Tania faces jail time because of the businesswoman's accusations.

Episodes.Title: Failed Mother
Episodes.Description: Tim confronts his mother after learning the true reason for his breakup with Poch. Soon, love reigns supreme as the old lovers finally reconcile. Sky digs deeper into Tori's past.

Episodes.Title: Family of Foes
Episodes.Description: Gino and Cecille discover the real cause of William's death. Roxy turns down Archie's request to be granted legal rights over Riley. Sky and her friends slowly unravel Tori's dark past and heinous crimes.

Episodes.Title: Scapegoat
Episodes.Description: Sky apologizes to her friends for dragging them into Tori's vengeful wrath. Nikki takes the fall for her mother's crimes, while Tori and Wesley go into hiding.

Episodes.Title: Hard Drive
Episodes.Description: Tim retrieves the files from Wesley's hard drive and makes another discovery about Tori and her children's malicious deeds. The police finally catch Tori's accomplice among them. Cheska comes clean to Sky, Tania, and Brandon.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplices
Episodes.Description: As the police interrogate all of Tori's accomplices, Wesley tries to convince his mother to leave the country. Still not receiving any help from her family, Nikki finds herself at wits' end. Edith seeks Poch's forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Meet Up
Episodes.Description: Tori confronts Yana, but the truth about her husband's atrocities finally convinces her to let go of her revenge. Wesley resorts to a desperate move to be with Sky as his obsession with her drives him to madness.

Episodes.Title: Grieving Mother
Episodes.Description: Devastating news about Wesley reignites Tori's desire for vengeance. With a job opportunity waiting for her abroad, Roxy decides to make amends with Archie. Cecille seeks Sky's forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Unreciprocated
Episodes.Description: Roxy gives Archie another chance. Sky lays bare her true feelings to Gino, while Tim reconciles with Edith. Soon, danger befalls Sky's family as Tori turns her grief into an ultimate revenge.

Episodes.Title: Twisted Justice
Episodes.Description: In her quest for twisted justice for herself and her family, Tori takes Tania and Star hostage. Racing against the clock, Sky is compelled to act when Tori coerces her into making a choice between her mother and her baby sister.

Episodes.Title: The Bomb
Episodes.Description: Sky's friends receive a message from Tori regarding Tania and Star's whereabouts, unknowingly falling into a death trap. Soon, Sky and Gino race against time to rescue their trapped loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Finale
Episodes.Description: To everyone's shock, Tori pulls one last trick up her sleeve just when she loses the upper hand. With a new shot at life given to them, Sky's family and friends try to forgive, move on, and forge new relationships.

Entries.Title: Sagrado
Entries.Description: The members of the Sagrado family live to prove they are the most powerful and influential, stopping at nothing to bury dirty secrets to keep their name faultless and sacred.

Episodes.Title: Brotherhood
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's opposition, Moises persists in attending Crestwood University. While seeking employment to fund his education, he meets Justin, a member of the influential Sagrado family, triggering a recollection of a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: While Justin and his Gamma Sigma Xi fraternity brothers work to conceal the death of their hazing victim, Moises stumbles upon crucial evidence that could shed light on the truth behind the victim's demise.

Episodes.Title: Newbie
Episodes.Description: Elias expresses his intention to run as president during Justin's birthday party. Tension rises among the Gamma Sigma Xi members amid the cover-up of Roland's tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Recruit
Episodes.Description: Moises joins Gamma Sigma Xi's recruitment only to be later prohibited by Estong during an unexpected visit to his dorm. While the school administration turns a blind eye to Roland's murder, a Sagrado member expresses empathy for the victim's family.

Episodes.Title: Initiation
Episodes.Description: As part of their initiation into Gamma Sigma Xi, Moises and his friends obey whatever the members command them, affecting their academic performance. The Sagrado family strategizes their campaign for the upcoming national elections.

Episodes.Title: Lookout
Episodes.Description: After meeting Justin's parents, Moises realizes how fortunate the young Sagrado is. Later, Gov. Rafael taps Moises for a secret task. Meanwhile, Moises becomes increasingly intrigued by Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Favor
Episodes.Description: As a favor to Nadia, Moises begins asking around in hopes of uncovering the truth about Roland's death. Because of this, Justin grows increasingly wary of the newcomer's investigation.

Episodes.Title: Hell Night
Episodes.Description: The hell night has finally arrived for the potential new members of Gamma Sigma Xi as they reach the final stage of initiation. However, Justin ensures things will be much more difficult for Moises as the latter probes into Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Member
Episodes.Description: The Gamma Sigma Xi members officially welcome Moises and his friends to their brotherhood. Estong discovers that Moises defied his orders and persisted in joining the fraternity.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises continues to get into Rafael's good graces, especially after the governor appreciated his kindness in helping the Salvacions seek justice for Roland's death. However, Moises' goodwill also brings Rafael closer to uncovering Justin's secret.

Episodes.Title: Pressure
Episodes.Description: Moises and his friends resort to desperate measures in hopes of squeezing the truth out of Percy. Meanwhile, unaware of yet another trouble Moises has gotten himself into, Estong refuses to give up on finding his estranged daughter.

Episodes.Title: Fear
Episodes.Description: Justin gloats as Crestwood University's administrators impose expulsion on Moises, seeking to silence his quest for justice for Roland. Meanwhile, Mercedes reverts to an old habit amid familial stress.

Episodes.Title: Ally
Episodes.Description: Moises reaches out to his Gamma Sigma Xi brothers for help in overturning the expulsion decision against him and his friends. Rafael pays the Salvacions a visit.

Episodes.Title: Reputation
Episodes.Description: The news about Moises' expulsion comes as a blow to Estong. Amid the campaign season for the upcoming national elections, the Sagrados pull strings to ensure that Roland's case stays under their control.

Episodes.Title: Scandal
Episodes.Description: Mercedes' jealousy catapults Rafael into a scandal, threatening her husband's candidacy. Moises' faith is tested as Estong's hospital bills start to pile up.

Episodes.Title: Damage Control
Episodes.Description: Rafael uses his housing project for damage control to gain favor with the voting public amidst his current issue. Estong's plea surprises Grace and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Overdose
Episodes.Description: Fearing her bloody secret would be exposed, Mercedes' restlessness leads her into danger. Fortunately, an unexpected guest in the mansion comes to her aid just in time. Elias continues to vie with Rafael for their party's presidential nomination.

Episodes.Title: Support
Episodes.Description: Mercedes recalls her dark secret as a strong sense of despair hits her. With Moises' readmittance to Crestwood, Justin prohibits him from further investigating Roland's death. Meanwhile, Rafael and Elias file for their candidacies.

Episodes.Title: Campaign
Episodes.Description: Moises and Grace volunteer to be part of Sagrados' campaign team as a gesture of gratitude for Rafael's unwavering assistance. Meanwhile, Nadia's suspicions against Rafael deepen, planting a seed of doubt in Moises.

Episodes.Title: Letter
Episodes.Description: Moises revisits Roland's old letters to Nadia in hopes of finding a connection between Percy and the late Crestwood student. Following the Sagrados’ successful campaign rally, a mysterious girl shows up and makes a surprising claim.

Episodes.Title: Guilty
Episodes.Description: A young woman shows up, claiming that Elias is her biological father. Meanwhile, Moises’ latest discovery sparks another conflict between him and Justin.

Episodes.Title: Proof
Episodes.Description: Maxene decides to join Felicia's sorority. Nadia confronts Rafael over her discovery about Percy. Moises finds a way to prove that Roland indeed applied to Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Heartbeat
Episodes.Description: Moises and Maxene form a deeper bond as they obtain the video that could implicate Justin in Roland's death. However, Moises finds himself in a dilemma as his family and friends remain loyal to the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Bribe
Episodes.Description: As Moises relentlessly pursues justice, Rafael attempts to threaten and bribe him. Meanwhile, Elias officially acknowledges Danica as his daughter and warmly welcomes her into his home.

Episodes.Title: Election
Episodes.Description: Election day has finally arrived. Meanwhile, the Sagrados use their connections to keep tabs on Moises as he continues assisting Nadia in finding concrete evidence to reopen Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Clash
Episodes.Description: The Sagrado tandem of Elias and Rafael celebrate their election victory. Justin confronts Moises at the fraternity house, resulting in a bloody brawl.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Justin's recklessness strains his relationship with his father, forcing him to come clean to Mercedes. At the hospital, Rafael tries to downplay the altercation between his son and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Arrested
Episodes.Description: Estong angrily confronts Rafael after learning about what happened to Moises. Much to the Malonzos' indignance, Rafael soon turns the tables on Moises regarding Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Moises and Justin face each other in the prosecutor's office, awaiting the decision on the former's murder case. While Moises receives unwavering support from his family, the Sagrados strengthen their bond in the face of adversity.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: As his uphill battle against the Sagrado family continues, Moises draws strength from his family and friends. Meanwhile, Danica airs her deep-seated grudges toward Elias and the Sagrado clan.

Episodes.Title: Setup
Episodes.Description: Unable to implicate Moises in Roland's murder, Justin ensures his former friend will face rightful punishment for defying him. Now the country's president, Elias defies Jaime's orders, much to the latter's annoyance.

Episodes.Title: Loyalty
Episodes.Description: Forced to go on the run, Moises turns to a Gamma Sigma Xi member for assistance. While Eleazar plants a seed of doubt in Rafael, Jaime confronts his brother for defying him.

Episodes.Title: Fugitive
Episodes.Description: After failing to capture Moi, Justin blatantly lies to the media, tarnishing his frat brother's reputation. Mercedes is left speechless by Diego's revelation. Rafael starts to entertain the possibility that Moi might be telling the truth.

Episodes.Title: Hulicam
Episodes.Description: Moises takes matters into his own hands and forces a confession from Justin. While her dark past continues to haunt Mercedes, Estong accosts Rafael for ruining his adopted son's life.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail
Episodes.Description: Diego uses Mercedes' dark past to blackmail her and extort money. As Moises' sole evidence against Justin falls into the Sagrados' hands, Maxene tells her friend that someone else still believes in his innocence.

Episodes.Title: Traitor
Episodes.Description: The manhunt operation against Moises continues as an unlikely person betrays him. While the Malonzos fight for justice, Eleazar starts to have second thoughts about the whole situation.

Episodes.Title: Stain
Episodes.Description: Eleazar is compelled to take action as Moises' case begins to tarnish the reputation of his family and the Gamma Sigma Xi. Meanwhile, Moises manages to get help from a Sagrado.

Episodes.Title: Defiance
Episodes.Description: Following Rafael's advice, Jaime devises a plan to prevent Elias from revealing the truth about their brotherhood's dilemma. Danica asks her dad to give Moi a chance to explain his side.

Episodes.Title: Hope
Episodes.Description: Moises finds renewed hope in Eleazar, unaware that the Sagrados remain one step ahead. Jaime reveals a shocking secret to his family as he decides to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Ingrate
Episodes.Description: Rafael is haunted by memories of a past romance as he tries to prove his love for Mercedes. Accused of ingratitude by Jaime, Eleazar soon faces the consequence of aiding Moises.

Episodes.Title: Dishonesty
Episodes.Description: Jaime fabricates more lies to cover up his crime. As Moises gets falsely implicated, Rafael starts to feel that his family's web of lies is spiraling out of control.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Diego tries to extort more money from Mercedes while revealing another shocking secret about the past. As Jaime grows determined to finish off Eleazar, Moises faces the media to confess.

Episodes.Title: Success
Episodes.Description: Jaime claims victory for the Sagrado family as Moises falsely confesses to all the crimes he is accused of. Meanwhile, Mercedes is haunted by a gruesome crime she committed in the past.

Episodes.Title: Threat
Episodes.Description: As Danica clings to hope for Eleazar's survival, Jaime urges Rafael to leverage his role as acting president for their family's benefit. Meanwhile, Moises faces the gravest threat to his life behind bars.

Episodes.Title: Conscience
Episodes.Description: With Moises' life in danger, Rafael and Divine's conscience pushes them to do the right thing. While trying to escape, Moises discovers the traitor in his midst.

Episodes.Title: Pit
Episodes.Description: With the discovery of human remains at the site of her housing project, Mercedes fears that her dark secret may soon be uncovered. Rafael tries to prove himself to Moises and earn his trust.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises urges Rafael to do the right thing and expose the truth. The Vice President, meanwhile, finds himself keeping a secret from his own family as Jaime learns about the disappearance of their scapegoat.

Episodes.Title: Pagmulat
Episodes.Description: Rafael finds himself torn between helping Moises and protecting his own family. Meanwhile, Diego continues to extort Mercedes in exchange for his silence.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Rafael continues to aid Moises as Eleazar prepares to wage war against their family. Jaime remains unperturbed by the turn of events, putting Divine between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Abduction
Episodes.Description: Foiling Divine's plan to escape her daughter, Jaime exposes their dirty work to Felicia. An unforeseen incident threatens to ruin Moises' chance of proving his innocence. Meanwhile Eleazar talks with his brother.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Moises turns to a trusted ally for help after finding himself in danger at the hands of the police. As the Sagrado family grapples with Rafael's abduction, the Vice President comes face to face with his captor.

Episodes.Title: Answer
Episodes.Description: While Moises contacts his family, Rafael returns home following his abduction. Estong and Grace stumble upo the cop investigating the remains found at the site of Mercedes' housing project.

Episodes.Title: Anak
Episodes.Description: Rafael's mysterious abduction sparks questions and speculation from both the public and his family. Meanwhile, Mercedes decides to strike back against Diego.

Episodes.Title: Revelation
Episodes.Description: General Arevalo resorts to violence in hopes of uncovering the identity of Moises' protector. Estong and Grace's world comes crashing down upon learning about Cristine's fate.

Episodes.Title: Agreement
Episodes.Description: While Moises continues to place his trust in him, Rafael confides in Divine about his plan to save Justin. Eleazar finds himself embroiled in another controversy. Melanie returns home.

Episodes.Title: Decision
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace feel a strong sense of regret as they mourn for Cristine's passing. Eleazar is forced to make a big decision, putting Moises' fate in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Finish
Episodes.Description: Moises feels betrayed by Eleazar's decision, while the Sagrado family celebrates Rafael's rise to power. Mercedes makes a deal with Diego to get rid of Moises once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Standoff
Episodes.Description: When Diego returns empty-handed, Mercedes takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Eleazar demands the return of his daughter and threatens Jaime, who remains oblivious to the betrayal brewing among those closest to him.

Episodes.Title: Doubt
Episodes.Description: Unaware of Danica's situation, Moises reaches out to her for help. Meanwhile, Nadia and Melanie suffer the consequence of aiding the Sagrados' archenemy.

Episodes.Title: Curse
Episodes.Description: While Rafael takes his oath as the new president, the police rush to Crestwood University in hopes of capturing Moises. Unbeknownst to them, a new ally comes to the boy's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Force
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace storm into Rafael's oath-taking ceremony to demand that he fulfill his promise to Moises, only to land in jail. Eleazar gatecrashes the Sagrados' celebration.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: Eleazar causes a scene at the Sagrados' celebration to pressure Jaime into freeing Danica. As the Malonzos get released from jail, Rafael soon learns about what happened to Grace.

Episodes.Title: Frat War
Episodes.Description: While deep in thought about her family's dire situation, Grace receives a glimmer of hope. Justin and his brothers confront Prof. Elmer, suspecting that Omega Alpha Rho is harboring Moi.

Episodes.Title: Discovery
Episodes.Description: As Eleazar faces arrest on corruption charges, Jaime forms a new alliance to solidify his hold on power. Despite his friend's sacrifice, Moises falls into the hands of his enemies. Rafael visits the Malonzos to offer his help.

Episodes.Title: Sin
Episodes.Description: After meeting with the Malonzos to assure them of his help, Rafael finds himself haunted by memories of his sinful affair. General Arevalo pressures Moises into revealing the identity of his accomplice.

Episodes.Title: Trust
Episodes.Description: Rafael finally finds Danica, while Ernesto and Grace are forced to trust an old foe to flee from Jaime's men. Later, the president secretly digs deeper into Cristine's mysterious death.

Episodes.Title: Atonement
Episodes.Description: Burdened by guilt over Cristine's fate, Rafael feels compelled to atone for his mistakes by helping Moises. Much to his father's disgust, Justin makes an appalling suggestion involving the enemies of the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Rafael and his security team set out on a mission to rescue both Moises and Danica. The president's actions, however, start to raise suspicions in Jaime.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Justin grows furious at the thought of his father siding with Moises. To make matters worse for the Sagrados, Rafael's action empowers Eleazar to strike back and wage war against them.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Jaime confronts Eleazar after his brother exposed his evil acts. While Rafael informs Justin about his deal with the ex-president, Mercedes grows increasingly fearful of what her husband might do once he learns the truth.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While defending Moises' innocence, Rafael exposes his and Jaime's wrongdoings. As Jaime prepares for his next move, Mercedes finds herself between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Pillar
Episodes.Description: Rafael learns that Cristine had given birth to a child before she died. Diego seeks Nadia and Melanie's forgiveness, hiding his true motive in coming back to their lives. Jaime warns Rafael about the consequences of betraying him.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: Eleazar warns Rafael about the full extent of Jaime's plans for revenge. As anticipated, Jaime has one final trick up his sleeve to locate Moises and Danica. Meanwhile, Rafael gets transferred to a new detention center.

Episodes.Title: Kapalit
Episodes.Description: Rafael escapes with the Malonzos, though his life remains in grave danger. An old threat to Moises' life reemerges as Mercedes learns about her husband's investigation into Cristine's murder.

Episodes.Title: Wanted
Episodes.Description: Rafael becomes a wanted fugitive following his escape, with Jaime showing no mercy toward his once-adopted son. Meanwhile, Justin's anger toward his father intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Pagtatagpo
Episodes.Description: Rafael arranges a meeting with Mercedes and Justin. However, danger looms as Justin, devastated by the truth about Moises, betrays his father and informs Jaime about the rendezvous.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Following a shocking revelation, an emotional Justin forces Rafael to choose between him and Moises. Mercedes's world crumbles as her husband makes a heartbreaking choice after learning the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Eleazar stands his ground when Jaime intimidates him into revealing Rafael's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Rafael returns to Moises, unaware that his adoptive father is on his way to them.

Episodes.Title: Preparation
Episodes.Description: Moises reunites with Maxene, who offers to help him and his family escape. While their enemies go into hiding, Jaime prepares Justin for the inevitable battle against Moises and Rafael.

Episodes.Title: Disguise
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Moises, Grace and Ernesto assume false identities as they seek refuge in Maxene's hometown. However, Moises's attempt to be of help puts their cover at risk of being exposed.

Episodes.Title: Riot
Episodes.Description: Divine's attempt to convince Felicia to stay away from Justin leads to a tragedy. Rafael seizes the chance to learn more about Moises through Grace. A riot erupts as Eleazar fights for his rightful claim to the presidency.

Episodes.Title: Inspiration
Episodes.Description: As Moises draws inspiration from Maxene to dream once more for his family, Justin strives to restore his family's reputation. Despite the bad news, Eleazar's action proves advantageous for him.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: Rafael savors the time spent with Moises while pretending to be father and son. At the same time, Moises finds the love and peace he has longed for in Maxene. Meanwhile, Eleazar remains steadfast in his fight for truth and injustice.

Episodes.Title: Sabotage
Episodes.Description: While Moises and Maxene enjoy a romantic rendezvous, Matias hides a secret of his own. Rafael confronts Justin about his attempts to tarnish his reputation and sway public opinion against him.

Episodes.Title: Trump Card
Episodes.Description: Rafael makes a tough decision to atone for his family's crimes. Matias and his group plan an uprising against their corrupt mayor, hinting at a hidden trump card against their enemy. Felicia receives heartbreaking news about her father.

Episodes.Title: Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Elias urges his frat brothers to support his claim to the presidency, prompting Jaime to kick him out of Gamma Sigma XI. As he is about to leave, Rafael gets caught off guard by Matias's revelations. Unknown to them, danger looms over their heads.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: Lorenzo informs Jaime about a surprise for his upcoming birthday celebration. As the mayor's forces close in, Rafael and his allies fiend themselves in imminent danger.

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: While Nadia and Diego head out to meet the former first lady, Mercedes plans a new demolition job against Rafael. Together with the wanted ex-president, Mattias and his group prepare to launch an attack against on Lorenzo's drug den.

Episodes.Title: Unbothered
Episodes.Description: Shaira receives a stern warning from Jaime. Soon, a news report exposes Rafael's past relationship with Cristine and alleges his involvement in her tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: As an intense confrontation unfolds between Nadia and Mercedes, another life falls into the Sagrados' hands. While Rafael and Mattias launch an attack against Mayor Lorenzo, Moises secretly sets out to help them.

Episodes.Title: Rescue
Episodes.Description: Moises comes to Rafael's rescue, only to be caught by Mayor Lorenzo's men. Getting wind of the latest news, Estong confronts Rafael when he returns without Moises. Meanwhile, Kelvin finds himself in danger.

Episodes.Title: Captive
Episodes.Description: Moises risks his life to escape from his captors. Rafael denies the allegations of masterminding Cristine's death. While Grace believes in Rafael's innocence, Estrong grows increasingly suspicious of him.

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: Tragedy befalls Nadia amid her attempt to expose the truth. Rafael and Mattias sneak into Mayor Lorenzo's mansion to rescue Moises. Justin prepares to punish Kelvin for betraying Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Defection
Episodes.Description: Unable to tolerate the brutal punishment inflicted on Kelvin, some frat members turn their backs on Justin and Gamma Sigma Xi. As controversies surround Jaime, cracks begin to form within his inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Gift
Episodes.Description: Divine and Felicia's chances of leaving the Sagrados dwindle after Justin learns about his girlfriend's pregnancy. An unexpected guest spoils Jaime's birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: Blood Ties
Episodes.Description: As they finally come face-to-face with Moises, Jaime and Justin try to turn him against Rafael. Meanwhile, the former president seeks the help of a powerful ally in his mission to save his captured son.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: While Jaime anticipates a grand family reunion, bloody combat ensues between Justin and Moises in the latter's desperate attempt to escape. With his grandson in danger, Ernesto resolves to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Territory
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Elias, and Grace storm into Lorenzo's territory in a daring attempt to rescue Moises. Meanwhile, Moises and Estong's heartfelt reunion is cut short as they soon face grave danger.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Grief engulfs the Malonzos and their allies as Moises' freedom comes at a high price. Despite Justin's warning, Felicia and Divine make another attempt to escape from the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jaime remains deeply wounded by Rafael and Elias' betrayals. While Elias vows to help the Malonzos find justice for their sufferings, Maxene tries to stop Moises from taking the law into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While Justin insists on marrying Felicia, Jaime confronts Divine for helping Rafael and Eleazar behind his back. Meanwhile, Moises reunites with his friends for refuge, unaware that Lorenzo's men have already tracked them down.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Mayor Lorenzo meets his downfall after his plans against Moises backfire on him. Rafael confronts Jaime about Moises' whereabouts and Cristine's death, unaware of a trap to capture him.

Episodes.Title: Father
Episodes.Description: Rafael spots Moises and attempts to bring him to safety, but Moises rejects him as his father and vows revenge on the Sagrados. Despite the growing public unrest, Justin pushes ahead with his plans to marry Felicia, unaware of the lurking threat.

Episodes.Title: Protest
Episodes.Description: With Grace and Melanie leading the charge, protesters claim victory as Jaime's allies fall one after another. While Eleazar reclaims his position, Jaime instructs Divine to plan their escape.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: While tragedy befalls Felicia after Justin discovers her betrayal, Jaime uses all means to escape upon realizing he has fallen into a trap. Soon, tables turn as Moises, and the other members of Gamma Sigma Xi hold Justin captive.

Episodes.Title: Brothers
Episodes.Description: After exposing the Sagrados' true face to the public, Moises ruthlessly punishes an unrepentant Justin. Rafael races against time to stop his sons fighting each other to the death.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Rafael joins Eleazar in his preparation for his presidential re-inauguration. Mercedes confronts Moises, only for the boy to learn the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: Standing at the crossroads, Rafael grapples with a heavy choice in order to save Moises' life. After Eleazar's re-inauguration ceremony ends in tragedy, a triumphant Jaime spills more blood.

Episodes.Title: Justice
Episodes.Description: After losing his remaining ally, Jaime attempts to kill Moises, but an unexpected person arrives to save the young Sagrado. Soon, retribution comes for the vicious kingmaker.

Episodes.Title: Changes
Episodes.Description: Rafael and Justin face their punishment, but not before reconciling with Moises. As Roland finally gets the justice he deserves, Moises leads a major change in Gamma Sigma Xi.

Entries.Title: Pulang Araw
Entries.Description: Red Sun is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines.

Episodes.Title: The story of Eduardo and Adelina during the war period!
Episodes.Description: Amidst fighting in the war, Eduardo continues to write a letter for his sister, Adelina, making her remember their early childhood memories, especially when their mother is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Adelina discovers the truth
Episodes.Description: After Adelina and Eduardo separate, Adelina finally discovers the world of vaudeville and her father's true life.

Episodes.Title: The discrimination against Adelina!
Episodes.Description: Now that Julio's big secret is out, Adelina faces the wrath of her father's wife, Carmela, as she steps into their lives.

Episodes.Title: Father and Son
Episodes.Description: After understanding the situation of Adelina and Eduardo, will Teresita choose to forgive her half-sister and start to move on with their lives?

Episodes.Title: Home on the Range
Episodes.Description: After a fire razes his theater to the ground, Julio desperately seeks help to rebuild it. Later, Hiroshi gives the family a well-meaning gift.

Episodes.Title: Julio disappeared without a trace!
Episodes.Description: Carmela discovers that her husband disappeared without a trace, and Julio's two daughters feel abandoned for what he did.

Episodes.Title: The promised dream of Teresita and Adelina
Episodes.Description: After their father’s sudden disappearance, Teresita and Adelina vowed to each other that they would do everything in their power to achieve their dream of performing in vaudeville, in honor of their father.

Episodes.Title: Teresita and Adelina continues to pursue their dream!
Episodes.Description: Teresita and Adelina secretly plan their next steps to pursue their dream of performing at the vaudeville, while hiding it from Carmela.

Episodes.Title: Adelina and Teresita fulfilled their promise to reach their dream
Episodes.Description: Despite Carmela's persistent threats, Teresita and Adelina remain committed to achieving their dream of performing at the vaudeville. Will their next audition finally bring them success?

Episodes.Title: Carmela's bitterness reached new heights!
Episodes.Description: Carmela’s decision sparks another chaos in the Borromeo household, affecting Adelina and Teresita’s plans and putting Eduardo in a tight spot.

Episodes.Title: The price to pay for Eduardo's freedom
Episodes.Description: Adelina gives Carmela an ultimatum to drop the lawsuit she filed against her brother. Will Adelina be able to pay the price for her demand?

Episodes.Title: The childhood friend of Teresita and Adelina returns
Episodes.Description: As Teresita, Adelina, and Eduardo make amends, one of their childhood friends, who left for Japan years ago, will be coming back to the Philippines.

Episodes.Title: The much-awaited day of Adelina and Teresita!
Episodes.Description: The much-awaited day of Adelina's and Teresita's vaudeville performance has come, and they are unaware that it will also be the day their beloved father Julio returns.

Episodes.Title: Julio and Carmela face each other again!
Episodes.Description: With the return of her long-lost husband, Julio, Carmela's life is about to be disrupted again. How will his return affect her plans?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi and Adelina meets again
Episodes.Description: After being separated from his friends for a long time, Hiroshi will finally have the chance to reconnect with Adelina. What will be their first step in rediscovering their friendship?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo confessed his secret desire for Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo tells Carmela about his real feelings for her daughter. Will he be able to confess his feelings to Teresita?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo and Teresita have feelings for each other!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and Teresita's friendship deepens as they come to realize their true feelings for each other.

Episodes.Title: Teresita was arranged to be married with Hiroshi!
Episodes.Description: Teresita finds herself in a tough spot after finding out about the marriage arrangement planned by Chikara and Carmela.

Episodes.Title: The marriage that will separate Adelina and Teresita!
Episodes.Description: As Teresita and Hiroshi's arranged marriage is finalized, Teresita learns that Adelina secretly has feelings for her future husband. How will this impact their family's plans?

Episodes.Title: The friendship of Adelina, Tereista, Hiroshi, and Eduardo, is torn apart
Episodes.Description: The friendship between Adelina, Teresita, Hiroshi, and Eduardo will be torn apart as a result of Teresita's and Hiroshi's arranged marriage.

Episodes.Title: The impending war brings fear!
Episodes.Description: Teresita and Adelina's families are concerned about the impending threat of the war between the Americans and the Japanese.

Episodes.Title: Anger and hatred against the Japanese started to grow
Episodes.Description: As the fierce battle between the Japanese and American forces continues, Hiroshi and the other Japanese soldiers are now in imminent danger.

Episodes.Title: Adelina starts to search for her only love, Hiroshi
Episodes.Description: As chaos breaks out in their country and tensions rise between the Japanese and Filipinos, Adelina will search for Hiroshi.

Episodes.Title: Adelina and Hiroshi confessed their feelings for each other
Episodes.Description: Adelina's and Hiroshi's might have a chance to reconcile as Teresita discovers Hiroshi’s true feelings toward her sister.

Episodes.Title: The feared war has arrived in the Philippines!
Episodes.Description: How will the Borromeo family manage to help Hiroshi before the dreaded war finally arrives in the Philippines?

Episodes.Title: The crime that will end the family of Hiroshi!
Episodes.Description: Lauro is determined to get the riches from the Tanaka family, even if it costs them their lives.

Episodes.Title: Justice for the Tanaka family!
Episodes.Description: Will Eduardo and the Borromeo family be able to secure justice for the Tanaka family following Lauro's crime?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi is engulfed by a deep sorrow and pain
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and Julio visit Hiroshi to deliver the devastating news about his beloved mother's death. How will Hiroshi accept this tragic revelation, knowing that Eduardo's relative is the one responsible for her demise?

Episodes.Title: Hiroshi attempts to flee from Filipino captors!
Episodes.Description: Hiroshi puts his life on the line after he decides to take a bold escape from Filipino's captivity. Will he be victorious in his attempt?

Episodes.Title: The life-changing decision in Hiroshi's hand
Episodes.Description: Hiroshi needs to make a crucial decision that could impact his future and that of Adelina Teresita and Eduardo.

Episodes.Title: The beautiful city of Manila became a battlefield!
Episodes.Description: The Japanese began invading and bombing Manila, leading to numerous Filipino casualties in the Japanese Imperial Army.

Episodes.Title: Carmela disapproves of her daughter's relationship!
Episodes.Description: Carmela is determined to prevent the growing relationship between Teresita and Eduardo and seems prepared to do whatever it takes to end it.

Episodes.Title: The Japanese invaders target the Borromeo family!
Episodes.Description: Will the Borromeo family find a way out of the danger they face after being targeted by the Japanese invaders?

Episodes.Title: The forbidden lovers' lives collide again!
Episodes.Description: Now that the Borromeos are residing with the Tanakas, Adelina's and Hiroshi’s paths cross again. Can their feelings for each other survive, with the lingering questions about the latter’s involvement in the Japanese invasion?

Episodes.Title: Teresita captivated the Japanese invader's heart!
Episodes.Description: Adelina and Teresita are forced to perform in front of the Japanese invaders, and it seems that Teresita's captivating beauty will win over an officer.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo and Teresita’s night of passionate love affair!
Episodes.Description: With the looming threat that the Japanese have brought into the country, Eduardo and Teresita spend time with each other before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: A Filipina's ordeal at the hands of the invaders!
Episodes.Description: Amalia endures hardships at the hands of the abusive Japanese invaders. Meanwhile, Carmela still insists on Teresita and Hiroshi's marriage.

Episodes.Title: Yuta's growing feelings for Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Now that Teresita's and Hiroshi's arranged marriage is no longer on the table, Yuta is determined to pursue her. Will Eduardo (Alden Richards) be able to take action against the colonel's actions?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo plans to elope with Teresita!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo proposes to Teresita that they should run away from their current lives and distance themselves from Colonel Yuta Saitoh.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo will face the torment of the Japanese!
Episodes.Description: After Eduardo failed to show up at their meeting place, Teresita, Adelina, and Hiroshi desperately searched for him, unaware that Colonel Yuta Saito and his men were preparing to torture the former.

Episodes.Title: The harshness of the Japanese invaders!
Episodes.Description: The Japanese Imperial Army seeks to clean up anything the Americans have touched to free the country from them, and one method is to punish the Filipinos through torture.

Episodes.Title: Eduardo will take matters into his own hands!
Episodes.Description: After enduring torment and witnessing the suffering of his fellow Filipinos, Eduardo decides to take matters into his own hands and find a way to escape the Japanese invaders.

Episodes.Title: The prisoners' daring escape from Japanese forces!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo and the other Filipino prisoners are set for their bold escape from the colonizers. Will they be able to attain the freedom they desperately long for?

Episodes.Title: The aftermath of Eduardo's grand escape
Episodes.Description: Colonel Yuta immediately orders his men to search for Eduardo after he escapes. Will he and Mario run free, or will the Japanese invaders capture them again?

Episodes.Title: Eduardo's next bold move!
Episodes.Description: As Eduardo reunites with Adelina and Teresita, they uncover the struggles he has endured and the crucial choices he must make to attain freedom.

Episodes.Title: The beginning of Eduardo's resistance!
Episodes.Description: Eduardo has decided to stand up and fight the invaders who are attempting to take advantage of them. How far will he go for his country?

Episodes.Title: The desperate strategy of a power-hungry mother!
Episodes.Description: Carmela is unwavering in her determination to connect her family with Colonel Yuta for power and protection, even if it goes against her family's wishes.

Episodes.Title: Yuta aggressively pursues Teresita!
Episodes.Description: With Carmela’s support, Yuta continues to pursue Teresita, despite her commitment to someone else. How will Adelina support her sister? Meanwhile, Eduardo and Mario continue searching for the guerrilla hideout.

Entries.Title: Lumuhod Ka Sa Lupa
Entries.Description: This is another action-drama film where the protagonist exacts payment of debts.

Episodes.Title: Sumabog sa Galit at Inggit si Miguel
Hinding-Hindi Pakakawalan ni Miguel si Mercy
S1.E51 ∙ Bagong yugto
Episodes.Description: As the new chapter begins, Miguel's evil plan against Abra also begins.

Episodes.Title: S1.E52 ∙ Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Miguel's plan to bring down Benito and Abra together continues. He orders Atoy and Nina to carry out the evil plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E53 ∙ Annulment
Episodes.Description: When Miguel receives Mercy's petition for annulment, he also discovers a major truth about Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E54 ∙ Tunay na ama
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally tells Abra that he's the father of Fatima. Miguel has become more determined than ever to reunite his family upon receiving the annulment papers.

Episodes.Title: S1.E55 ∙ Dehado
Episodes.Description: A surprise armed attack on the Balmores mansion led to an unexpected outcome. Meanwhile, Abra confronts Miguel at the law firm after getting ahold of Balmores' signed Durable Power Of Attorney.

Episodes.Title: S1.E56 ∙ Fake Hero
Episodes.Description: After Miguel's plan to get Abra arrested succeeds, he takes another step further by "rescuing" Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E57 ∙ Manipula
Episodes.Description: Mercy confronts Miguel after visiting his mansion. Meanwhile, Abra is determined to get out of the provincial jail as quickly as possible, but danger lurks in every corner.

Episodes.Title: S1.E58 ∙ Kasunduan
Episodes.Description: Abra finally confronts Atoy about his motivation to set Abra up after being transferred to the same jail cell. Jane persuades Bea to cut ties with Tom.

Episodes.Title: S1.E59 ∙ Riot
Episodes.Description: After hearing the news from the jail warden that Abra is about to be released from the provincial jail, Miguel orders the jail warden to set a final trap against Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E60 ∙ Pangontra
Episodes.Description: After reuniting, Abra and Mercy talk about their next plan to rescue Fatima. Miguel enlists the help of Jane to ruin Abra's public image. Brando is beginning to question Abra's loyalty to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E61 ∙ Bihag
Episodes.Description: Abra's promise to help Atoy rescue Fatima comes to fruition. With the help of his team, they set their plan in motion by going to Atoy's employer's house, Balat.

Episodes.Title: S1.E63 ∙ Salisi
Episodes.Description: A homesick Fatima attempts to escape from their house after being kept from her mother and grandfather by Miguel for so long. Bea gets the courage to ask Tom for an unusual favor.

Episodes.Title: S1.E64 ∙ Kampihan
Episodes.Description: Abra has become desperate to find help with an unlikely acquaintance after exhausting his options to find and rescue Fatima. Meanwhile, Miguel and Fatima's relationship worsens.

Episodes.Title: S1.E65 ∙ Utakan
Episodes.Description: As Abra and his team uncover Fatima's location, they prepare themselves in a race against time after Jane breaks the news about Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E66 ∙ Sagip
Episodes.Description: After failing to get to Miguel's house on time, Abra and his team work together to catch Miguel's car and rescue Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E67 ∙ Damdamin
Episodes.Description: Abra successfully rescues Fatima, reuniting her with Mercy. Meanwhile, a desperate Miguel contacts Jane in the hopes of involving her in another one of his schemes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E68 ∙ Alinlangan
Episodes.Description: Jane's in deep water after Miguel sends her to gather information to use against Abra. Meanwhile, Brando suspects something out of Abra and Mercy's real relationship.

Episodes.Title: S1.E69 ∙ Kadugo
Episodes.Description: As Mercy learns about Elizabeth, her half-sister--- her dismay toward Judge Benito grows stronger. Norman and Obet escorts Atoy and Nina in leaving Rosario, with Miguel's men in hot pursuit.

Episodes.Title: S1.E70 ∙ Power
Episodes.Description: Already furious about Abra's involvement in the escape of Atoy, Miguel's wrath can be felt inside the Balmores Law firm as Mercy arrives together with Abra to assert her power as an Attorney-in-fact of Judge Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E71 ∙ Takeover
Episodes.Description: Miguel intends to kill Abra as he learns the latter confirms its attendance in the upcoming Alamid meeting, his father opposes the idea. Meanwhile, Mercy notices that Fatima develops a trauma after the kidnapping incident. Abra vows to do everything to stop Miguel from hurting them again.

Episodes.Title: S1.E72 ∙ Pag-amin
Episodes.Description: Abra gets carried away and confesses his love to Mercy. With Fatima's safety in jeopardy, Mercy decides to set aside her real feelings. Meanwhile, Jane can't stand seeing Abra, her one great love-- hurting over unrequited love. It pains her too.

Episodes.Title: S1.E73 ∙ Sawi
Episodes.Description: After an awkward drunken encounter with Abra, Jane begins to distance herself from Abra. Meanwhile, Elizabeth finally arrives at the Balmores mansion to live with her half-sister, Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E74 ∙ Panggulo
Episodes.Description: Abra finally meets Elizabeth, Mercy's estranged half-sister. Miguel brews a new sinister plan after losing most of what he cherishes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E75 ∙ Buwelta
Episodes.Description: Miguel calls for a meeting with the Alamid members to complete his plan. Despite warnings from his friends and allies, Abra is still determined to attend the Alamid meeting.

Episodes.Title: S1.E76 ∙ Bagsik
Episodes.Description: As the meeting between Alamid members begins, an unexpected guest shows up that shakes up Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E77 ∙ Kastigo
Episodes.Description: The return of Benito Balmores from a coma turned Miguel's plan upside down. Miguel takes Abra hostage as he runs away with his father, Mario, to escape the newly awakened judge's wrath.

Episodes.Title: S1.E78 ∙ Pugante
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Miguel's escape, Abra was hospitalized due to his injuries while fighting Miguel. Benito tasked his subordinates to hunt down Miguel and brands him as a fugitive in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E79 ∙ Pangamba
Episodes.Description: With Benito Balmores' return to power, Abra and Mercy agree to protect their daughter, Fatima from her grandfather. Meanwhile, Atoy and Nina continue to live a peaceful life despite potential threats looming over them.

Episodes.Title: S1.E80 ∙ Kontrolado
Episodes.Description: Benito calls for a meeting with his subordinates to discuss their next move against Miguel. Atoy and Nina argue about their situation and involvement in helping Abra fight against Benito Balmores.

Episodes.Title: S1.E81 ∙ Tiwala
Episodes.Description: Abra tries to contact Atoy but to no avail. Corcerned about Nina and Atoy's safety, Abra and friends goes to their last known location-- only to discover that they were no longer staying there. Benito's suspicion rises and for Abra to regain the judge's trust again, he agrees to take a special mission with Elizabeth as his partner in crime.

Episodes.Title: S1.E82 ∙ Prinsipyo
Episodes.Description: While on a mission, Abra struggles to let go of his principles. Elizabeth senses it and uses Abra's moral dilemma to her advantage. Meanwhile, Mercy follows Brando. Abra's involvement in her father's dirty deed saddens the clueless Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E83 ∙ Konsensya
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra's involvement, Mercy decides not to use the video footage against Judge Benito Balmores. Abra reassures Mercy; he finally confesses to her.

Episodes.Title: S1.E84 ∙ Alyansa
Episodes.Description: Due to constant involvement in violence, Atty. Abra struggles to believe that he is still a good man fighting an evil man. In the end, Mercy convinces the attorney to help her with her candidacy; their only hope to take the evil judge down.

Episodes.Title: S1.E85 ∙ Tindig
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally announces to the public that she will run as a governor of Rosario; promising to eradicate corruption first if elected; upon hearing Mercy's true agenda-- Judge Balmores withdraws his support for Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E86 ∙ Mothering
Episodes.Description: Mercy is finally breaking free from Benito's control. Meanwhile, Mother Eu is helping Miguel rise up to seek revenge against Benito and regain power in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E87 ∙ Sanib pwersa
Episodes.Description: Abra is about to introduce Mercy to his allies who will help her in her fight to win the election. However, Benito will quickly find a way to bring Mercy back under his control.

Episodes.Title: S1.E88 ∙ Sabotahe
Episodes.Description: Due to Benito's sabotage of potential financiers for Mercy's campaign, Abra and Jane will find a way to counter it. Meanwhile, Mother Eu and Miguel are planning how to attack Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E89 ∙ Pagkakataon
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra, Mr. Sampaga agrees to a meeting to hear Mercy's plans-but with one condition Abra must attend; otherwise, he won't talk to a Balmores. As the scheduled time for their meeting approaches, Benito summons Abra for a mission.

Episodes.Title: S1.E90 ∙ Paghimok
Episodes.Description: Besides the importance of convincing Mr. Sampaga for his support, it is even more crucial to gain the trust of the people. The battle for Mercy Balmores' candidacy is about to begin.

Episodes.Title: S1.E91 ∙ Paramdam
Episodes.Description: Miguel's presence resurfaces in Rosario, and the first thing he disrupts is Mercy's campaign. Meanwhile, Benito's violence is felt as he searches for those supporting Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E92 ∙ Lusob
Episodes.Description: Due to Elizabeth's surveillance, Mercy's financier is confirmed. Mr. Sampaga's life is in danger because of Judge Balmores' sinister plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E93 ∙ Responde
Episodes.Description: Mother Eu and Miguel leave a message at the gate of the Balmores Mansion Manong's corpse.

Episodes.Title: S1.E94 ∙ Tatsulok
Episodes.Description: Although Mr. Sampaga was successfully rescued, Jane's happiness is incomplete due to the rekindled closeness between Mercy and Abra. Confessions are about to be made.

Episodes.Title: S1.E95 ∙ Blackmail
Episodes.Description: As the Alamid forces continue to grow, so does the intensification of plans to bring down Mercy's candidacy. Under pressure from Elizabeth, Abra is forced to confess to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E96 ∙ Babala
Episodes.Description: Miguel warns Benito and Abra about his revenge. Jane also learns about Miguel's next plan to take back Mercy and Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E97 ∙ Pagsangga
Episodes.Description: During Miguel's assault, Mercy and Fatima find themselves threatened, but Abra intervenes to protect them, putting himself in grave danger.

Episodes.Title: S1.E98 ∙ Lamat
Episodes.Description: Despite Mercy's improving position in the election, Benito begins to suspect Abra's true nature.

Episodes.Title: S1.E99 ∙ Troll Farm
Episodes.Description: As the relationship between Benito and Abra continues to deteriorate, Mother Eu and Miguel plan to take them down. Mother Eu suggests finding out any secret about Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E100 ∙ Hinala
Episodes.Description: The smear campaigns and character assassination against Mercy seem to be succeeding. Meanwhile, as Abra attacks the troll farm, a lurking danger awaits.

Episodes.Title: S1.E101 ∙ Pag-usig
Episodes.Description: Benito confronts Abra for the sabotage at the troll farm. Meanwhile, Miguel reappears to introduce Jane to Mother Eu.

Episodes.Title: S1.E102 ∙ Pandaraya
Episodes.Description: Benito offers a coalition to Gov. Uy to ensure victory in the election against Mercy. Jane worries about Abra's safety, especially since Benito now harbors significant suspicion about him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E103 ∙ Pananakot
Episodes.Description: Abra and Mercy face the task of vote-buying. However, Benito orders Brando to get ahead of Abra and Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E104 ∙ Salba
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth offers to team up with Abra by providing an information. Masked Abra tries to save Kap Rodel from brando's men-- endangering his cover.

Episodes.Title: S1.E105 ∙ Pagtutuos
Episodes.Description: Overjoyed by their small victory, Mercy and Abra takes a little moment to appreciate each other. Fueled by anger and jealousy, Miguel tails Abra's car as danger awaits them both.

Episodes.Title: S1.E106 ∙ Kapit
Episodes.Description: Almost defeated in a fist fight by Abra, Miguel manages to get his hands near Jane and Mercy--using them for a chance to escape. Abra, literally holding both Mercy and Jane's life in the palm of his hand--who can he save?

Episodes.Title: S1.E107 ∙ Takot
Episodes.Description: Jane's finally in an stable condition. As the accident leaves no alarming physical damage, it brings big impact to Abra and Jane's relationship. Will Abra be able to win her trust again?

Episodes.Title: S1.E108 ∙ Asintado
Episodes.Description: Ready, aim, shoot. As the election day draws nearer, Elizabeth agrees to do a dangerous mission. Someone's going to get bloody, who would it be?

Episodes.Title: S1.E109 ∙ Hitman
Episodes.Description: As Leonardo learns who orchestrated the assassination attempt--a more shocking revelation unfolds.

Episodes.Title: S1.E110 ∙ Laglagan
Episodes.Description: Abra saves Elizabeth from Benito's corrupt policemen. Meanwhile, nightmares starts to haunt Jane in her sleep.

Episodes.Title: S1.E111 ∙ Prayoridad
Episodes.Description: Brando suspects Abra of hiding Elizabeth and pays a surprise visit to his home; As Abra visits Jane in the hospital, Brando and his men searches Abra's house leaving the lone Elizabeth in an exposed location.

Episodes.Title: S1.E112 ∙ Pagtanggap
Episodes.Description: Fearing that Benito's men will soon find Elizabeth, Abra brings her to the safehouse. Hesitant at first, but through Abra's convincing-- the group agrees to give Elizabeth another chance.

Episodes.Title: S1.E113 ∙ Hikayat
Episodes.Description: Furious at Abra for exposing the groups safehouse to an enemy, Jane angrily confronts both Elizabeth and Abra. To prove her sincerity, Elizabeth reveals Benito's plan to ambush Mercy's supporters on election day.

Episodes.Title: S1.E114 ∙ Mass Grave
Episodes.Description: In the middle of the rescue mission, Elizabeth sacrifices herself to be the target of Brando and his goons. Giving Jane and Abra the opportunity to pull Kap Ed and his people out of the mass grave.

Episodes.Title: S1.E115 ∙ Gahol
Episodes.Description: Abra, Jane, and the voters chase the cutoff for voting. Abra is very grateful to Elizabeth for helping stop Benito's evil plan. However, Jane still doubts Elizabeth's intentions. The true results of the election are about to be revealed.

Episodes.Title: S1.E116 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: In the midst of Mercy's defeat in the election, she and Abra, with the help of the voters, are protesting the true results. Atoy, meanwhile, is resurfacing to fulfill his promise to Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E117 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: Abra is filled with hope again because of the new plan with Atoy. But even before they meet, Elizabeth sabotages him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E118 ∙ Hinanakit
Episodes.Description: Brando tails Abra en route to Atoy's place. As he finds Nina, Brando kills her first. Abra and Atoys manages to escape successfully. Grieving Atoy regrets reconnecting with Abra and blames him for Nina's death.

Episodes.Title: S1.E119 ∙ Sabwatan
Episodes.Description: Jane reassures Miguel about there plan against Benito. Although defeated, Mercy continues her public service, gaining the support of an eye witness-- enough to file an electoral protest against Leonardo Uy. Meanwhile, through Elizabeth's help, Judge Benito is already aware about the name's of Abra's inner group.

Episodes.Title: S1.E120 ∙ Moralidad
Episodes.Description: Mercy brings a new witness to Abra against Gov. Uy's election fraud. However, Norman's fears for the witness's safety prevail. Meanwhile, Jane is gradually changing. Mother Eu and Miguel are putting together a big plan to finally bring down Benito.

Entries.Title: How to Spot a Red Flag
Entries.Description: A spunky barista is torn between two gorgeous looking men - a confident bad boy and a charming good boy who are both involved in catfishing her. Despite noticing the red flags in the two men, is it still possible for her to find real love?

Episodes.Title: Talking Stage
Episodes.Description: Cha, a spunky coffee shop owner, finds solace in her online friend Matt whom she has yet to meet in person. However, everything changes when she finally comes face-to-face with the guy she's currently in the talking stage with.

Episodes.Title: Cheater
Episodes.Description: Cha crosses paths with Matt while uncovering the secret behind a trending coffee mix. Matt, on the other hand, discovers that someone close to him is the catfish who got him canceled online.

Episodes.Title: Code Red
Episodes.Description: Matt apologizes to Cha. However, reminded of how he owes JR his life, a guilt-ridden Matt hesitates to tell Cha the truth and instead makes a deal with his friend.

Episodes.Title: Beach Please
Episodes.Description: JR comes to Matt's rescue after Cha asked the latter out on a surf date. However, the barista considers ditching the plan when Ime disapproves of her action.

Episodes.Title: MattCha
Episodes.Description: Matt ends up enjoying his surf date with Cha. An untoward incident brings them closer, but those around them seem unhappy about it. Later, Cha makes a realization.

Episodes.Title: Sus
Episodes.Description: Cha's suspicions about Matt grow stronger as they become text mates while recovering from their sprains. To confirm her hunch, the barista pays her friend a surprise visit, only to lead to more confusion.

Episodes.Title: Yellow There Mysteryoso
Episodes.Description: Cha finally confirms that the person standing before her is not the same Matt she met online. After a heartfelt talk with Marian, Matt goes out of his way to find Cha and confess.

Episodes.Title: Breadcrumbing
Episodes.Description: Matt finds it difficult to come clean to Cha as they spend more time together at the coffee farm. However, a sudden request will bring them back to square one.

Episodes.Title: Confused Hearts
Episodes.Description: Refusing to ruin the happy moment he shares with Cha, Matt once again decides to postpone his confession and instead tries to boost JR's image with her. However, to Matt's surprise and confusion, Cha agrees to meet JR and go on a date with him.

Episodes.Title: Busted
Episodes.Description: Matt is forced to do the right thing when JR fails to come clean to Cha, only to hurt the barista's feelings unintentionally. Meanwhile, Marian discovers an anomaly under JR's watch and reports it to Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Catching Feelings
Episodes.Description: Cha struggles to accept that she is catching feelings for the real Matt, despite the deceit. Despite doing the right thing, guilt weighs on Matt for hurting two of the most important people in his life.

Episodes.Title: Manifesting
Episodes.Description: JR apologizes to Cha and learns that Ayat Blends is about to close down. While JR plans to take advantage of Cha's dilemma to win her over, Matt finds a thoughtful way to help her and the displaced workers.

Episodes.Title: Trabahohol
Episodes.Description: Despite her initial rejection, Cha decides to accept the job offer at Legacy Cafe for the sake of her team. Matt tries to be professional with Cha on her first day, while Marian reunites with Vivian after receiving a task from Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Special Treatment
Episodes.Description: Despite Matt's effort to clear the air between them, Cha remains reluctant as she becomes determined to fight her growing feelings for him. Meanwhile, JR seizes an opportunity to get closer to Cha, causing Matt to seethe with jealousy.

Episodes.Title: One Shot
Episodes.Description: JR finds a new opportunity to spend time alone with Cha. This time, Matt refuses to let them be, even going so far as to see JR flirting with the girl he likes.

Episodes.Title: Best Man
Episodes.Description: With her parents’ support, Cha grows determined to revive Ayat Blends Café. Matt confesses his true feelings for Cha to JR and finally decides to pursue her. Unwilling to back down, JR steps up his game—both at work and in winning Cha’s heart.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: When Cha loses her precious necklace, Matt and JR both rush to help her find it, each with their own approach to winning her favor. While JR spends more time with Cha at work, Matt focuses on making amends with Cha’s parents.

Episodes.Title: Perfectly Imperfect
Episodes.Description: Seeing JR feeling down after a tense confrontation with his father, Cha steps in as a friend. Upon learning of JR's dilemma, Matt, without hesitation, rushes to his aid, which leads Cha to a new lead in the scam that started it all.

Episodes.Title: Sigma Wars
Episodes.Description: JR takes Cha to the beach to keep her from going to the precinct. A surfing match breaks out when Ime spots Cha and JR together and orders Matt to separate them.

Episodes.Title: And the Winner Is
Episodes.Description: The rivalry between Matt and JR intensifies as they ramp up their efforts to win Cha's favor. Despite the new developments in the scam case, Cha finds little cause for celebration, caught between two good friends now at odds because of her.

Episodes.Title: Passenger Princess
Episodes.Description: Not wanting to put too much pressure on Cha, Matt and JR set aside their differences and reach a compromise. JR is frozen in place upon hearing the news of Jackie Bartolome’s arrest.

Episodes.Title: Red Alert
Episodes.Description: Cha and Matt's trip to the precinct proves futile when the authorities refuse to let her speak with Jackie Bartolome. As the case begins to take its toll on Cha, JR and Matt decide to call a truce.

Episodes.Title: White Flag
Episodes.Description: After Cha's alarming panic attack, Matt makes a thoughtful gesture to help her feel better. Later, Matt overhears JR’s phone conversation and finally discovers his friend’s true colors.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Will Set You Free
Episodes.Description: Setting aside his feelings, Matt tries to make Cha understand where JR is coming from. Leandro promises to stand by his son upon learning of his situation.

Episodes.Title: Night 2 Remember
Episodes.Description: Matt and JR face off once again, this time in a coffee-making contest during Legacy’s anniversary night. As this year’s best barista, Cha gets the final say in selecting the winning brew—and ultimately, the man who will win her heart.

Entries.Title: Chasing in the Wild
Entries.Description: Sevi is a basketball captain from a humble family. Elyse is a spoiled cheerleader. Though opposites, the two fall for each other. But can their young love survive the harsh realities that may come their way?

Episodes.Title: The Team Captain and the Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: It’s a contentious first meeting for Sevi and Elyse at the latter’s debut party. However, a mishap at the party signals the start of the two’s constant interaction, often to Elyse’s annoyance and Sevi’s amusement.

Episodes.Title: Nothings Into Somethings?
Episodes.Description: Elyse loses a bet with Sevi. Even though it might just go against her values as a cheerleader, Elyse goes through with the consequence of losing the bet, leading to confused feelings for Sevi.

Episodes.Title: The Case of Forgotten Things
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi continue to hang out. But Elyse somehow starts feeling jealous of Luna.

Episodes.Title: Whatever You Call It
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi get into a fight and keep their distance from each other. They end up meeting again at a party. But it’s awkward. Can the two make up and get back to how they were before?

Episodes.Title: Your Biggest Fan
Episodes.Description: Sevi admits his feelings for Elyse. But Elyse doesn’t really know how to respond to that. At the same time, they’re also both busy with their respective competitions.

Episodes.Title: Winner Takes All
Episodes.Description: Elyse shows her support for Sevi during his game, leading to a great game for him. But Elyse has prepared an even bigger surprise for Sevi.

Episodes.Title: Life and Love and Seasons
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi continue to date but it seems it won’t be easy, especially having to hide their relationship from Alfred.

Episodes.Title: Milestones
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi look back on their relationship as they now finally move in together.

Episodes.Title: Unit 1432
Episodes.Description: As Elyse and Sevi live in together, family problems trouble Sevi and keep him busy, leaving Elyse lonely.

Episodes.Title: The Mourning After
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi take a break from their relationship. Will they find their way back together again?

Episodes.Title: I Love You, But
Episodes.Description: Elyse is still reeling from losing her mom. Could Sevi and Elyse’s relationship survive this tragedy?

Episodes.Title: The CEO and The Head Engineer
Episodes.Description: Years after their break up, Elyse and Sevi find themselves having to work together on a project.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Ground
Episodes.Description: Elyse finds herself in trouble. Despite the awkwardness, Sevi helps Elyse. But now, Sevi and Elyse are confused by all the mixed signals

Episodes.Title: Unit 1432, Part II
Episodes.Description: Elyse ends up staying in the condo with Sevi, but only as housemates and co-owners of the condo. But it’s hard when the past always seems to creep back up.

Episodes.Title: Nostalgia Is A Dangerous Thing
Episodes.Description: Elyse and Sevi start to see how living together with an ex is difficult. Aside from having to keep it a secret from others, feelings from the past get harder to deny.

Episodes.Title: Five Years of Remembering
Episodes.Description: Afraid of the past repeating itself, Elyse decides to move out of their condo once again.

Episodes.Title: What are we?
Episodes.Description: Elyse learns that Sevi was planning on gifting Elyse a ring. But Elyse doesn’t know what kind of ring it was, and more importantly, she doesn’t even know what the status of their relationship is.

Episodes.Title: Almost Happy Ending
Episodes.Description: An accident has occurred at the Batangas site. Even worse, Sevi is being implicated in the incident.

Entries.Title: My Guardian Alien
Entries.Description: An alien disguised as a human woman must protect Earth from an intergalactic threat while hiding her identity from her husband.

Episodes.Title: The alien is now Doy's friend!
Will Dr. Ceph meet the alien?
The alien is now fully charged!
The face-off of Venus and the alien

Entries.Title: Zoomers
Entries.Description: A youth-oriented series that revolves around the lives of senior high school students Jiggs, Hope, Kokoy, Tania, and Atom, who have forged a special bond of friendship during the pandemic. As they find their footing in this post-pandemic reality, witness how their friendship will be tested; as they will be challenged by their own pains, struggles, and dreams.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: On the first day of face-to-face classes, Jiggs brims with excitement as he looks forward to meeting the members of a chat group called "Zoomers." However, his excitement turns to surprise when he finally sees his online friends in person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jiggs receives discouraging news about his film festival application. Despite his friends' words of warning, he applies for an apprenticeship with a millennial filmmaker known for his accomplishments but also for his risky pastime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jiggs draws inspiration for his new film project from his friends, developing a special connection with Hope along the way. However, Hope's complicated situation puts their blossoming friendship to the test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jiggs continues to give Hope the cold shoulder. Mika brings Kokoy to a bar to help the young man forget his problems. Tania accidentally witnesses something shocking in her condo building’s lobby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After landing an opportunity to do a collab video with famous beauty influencer Faye, Tania finds something more than friendship blooming between the two of them. The Zoomers, meanwhile, unite and find a way to support Tania's passion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tania's coming-out video garners a hostile reaction from an unexpected person. Jiggs takes the first step to patch things up with Hope. Later, Tania confides in Dino about a private matter concerning their friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Tania confides a secret in Dino, only to be betrayed by him when he drops the bombshell to the group during a game and causes a rift. Soon, Atom discovers the real reason behind Dino's motive for befriending them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Atom faces expulsion as Dino's accusations against him spread around the school. Worried about their friend's well-being, the Zoomers look for evidence to clear Atom's name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Atom falls into despair as his schoolmates bash him online and ostracize him. Dino, on the other hand, brims with satisfaction as everyone on campus believes him, unaware of the trap he is stepping into.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Grateful for his friends' help in clearing his name, Atom promises to be a better person. While Mika and Kokoy receive his blessing, Jiggs stirs emotions with his latest work.

Episodes.Title: Anniverslay
Episodes.Description: As Jiggs receives an invitation to a short film competition promoting a beach resort, the Zoomers tag along to celebrate their friendship's first anniversary. Amid their summer getaway, however, a shadow from the past leaves Atom on edge.

Episodes.Title: F.O.M.O.
Episodes.Description: Jiggs faces a stumbling block as he crosses paths anew with an old foe, who happens to be one of the competition's organizers. Dino's presence at the resort alarms the Zoomers, especially when they struggle to find Hope.

Episodes.Title: A Sticky Situation
Episodes.Description: Mika reunites with a childhood friend, arousing Kokoy's jealousy. Tania finds herself in an awkward encounter with Faye at the resort. Hope receives devastating news about her scholarship application.

Episodes.Title: Hits Different
Episodes.Description: Mika's closeness with Enzo makes things difficult for Kokoy. Jiggs discovers a potential solution to Hope's financial problems. Atom continues his efforts to reconnect with Dino and help him recover from their past.

Episodes.Title: Vibe Check
Episodes.Description: Jiggs remains wary of Dino. Hiding his jealousy over Mika and Enzo's closeness, a drunk Kokoy confronts his rival in love. Tania tries to patch things up with Faye, unaware of a person getting in the way of their reconciliation.

Episodes.Title: Cancelled
Episodes.Description: The Zoomers welcome Dino to Jiggs' film production. Just when Tania resolves not to hold on to her feelings for Faye, the latter makes a confession that surprises her. Hope's trust in Jiggs is tested when she receives an enticing job offer.

Episodes.Title: Forda Fam
Episodes.Description: Tania helps Faye get through her dilemma. A message from Lone Wolf threatens to put the Zoomers in danger. Soon, secrets and hidden feelings come to light as tension rises among the group amid a power outage.

Episodes.Title: That's Sus
Episodes.Description: Beth helps Atom calm down while Mika tries to talk some sense into Jiggs after altercations break out amid the power outage. Just as the dust slowly settles, everyone gets shocked when the police arrive to arrest Jiggs.

Episodes.Title: Unhinged
Episodes.Description: Mika finds comfort in Kokoy following Jiggs' sudden arrest, leading the two into a situation they soon regret. With Dino's help, the Zoomers prove Jiggs' innocence and confront the person who framed him.

Episodes.Title: Finally
Episodes.Description: Tania makes a heartbreaking discovery about her best friend. As the bond between the Zoomers becomes even more unbreakable following their ordeal, the mysterious Lone Wolf lies in wait for them.

Entries.Title: Marahuyo Project
Entries.Description: Join King as he journeys through the highly traditional town of Marahuyo, meeting new friends and finding love along the way as he lobbies to create the first LGBTQIA+ org in their campus.

Episodes.Title: Amihan
Episodes.Description: King is exiled to Marahuyo after a conflict with the college dean. Reuniting with his mother and grandmother, he attends Mariano Soliman University (MarSU) where he befriends Venice, a transgender student. Witnessing Venice's struggles, he starts an LGBTQ+ student organization at MarSU.

Episodes.Title: Dios Buhawi
Episodes.Description: King meets the annoying, rule-abiding student council president Ino who rejects his application to start his student org due to the low number of LGBTQ+ students. Out to prove Ino wrong, King and Venice attend a house party to search and recruit their fellow community members.

Episodes.Title: Sidapa At Bulan
Episodes.Description: After successfully recruiting Venice and Lorie, King returns to Ino to have their org application approved. Meanwhile, Lorie contemplates whether joining the org is a good idea or not.

Episodes.Title: Santelmo
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie are suspended and assigned to do community service. Ino attempts to get closer to King. Elsewhere, Venice seeks to reconnect with Archie as their past catches up to them.

Episodes.Title: Hunyango
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie, together with Ino, do research on the rich history of Marahuyo for their school board pitch. Meanwhile, Archie ponders on how he wants to live his life and Lorie discovers the truth about Lili.

Episodes.Title: Sirena
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, Lorie and Ino pay an elderly resident a visit for an interview about the town’s past. As they find out the forgotten past of the town, Ino learns about the painful secret about his family.

Episodes.Title: Aswang
Episodes.Description: King, Venice, and Lorie search for Lili who disappeared after her sexuality is revealed. Elsewhere, Ino’s newfound courage is tested as he prepares for the annual Balagtasan.

Episodes.Title: Babaylan
Episodes.Description: Now reunited with Ino after his grand public revelation and impeachment as student council president, King, Venice and Lorie defend their org’s purpose and existence in front of the school board.

Entries.Title: Sky Valley
Entries.Description: In the first tale, Junjun, a horseman working at the resort, finds himself irresistibly drawn to Fourth, a mysterious guest whose arrival stirs up deep emotions. The second story follows Paris, a vlogger from Manila, who falls for Taylor, the daughter of the resort's owner, sparking a passionate romance amidst the stunning backdrop of Sky Valley Park.

Entries.Title: Haunted Hearts
Entries.Description: After a car accident leaves him with amnesia, Jack is determined to rediscover himself using a bucket list. His latest adventure leads him to a Halloween party at a mysterious mansion, where he meets Magic, the charismatic yet elusive owner. But as Jack falls for Magic, he uncovers a shocking secret—Magic is a ghost tied to a dark past that is more connected to Jack than he could have ever imagined.

Episodes.Title: Spirits and Spells: The Battle for Magic’s House

Entries.Title: Oh My Boo
Entries.Description: Have you ever experienced falling in love, getting hurt, and being GHOSTED? Watch out for true love that is "till death do us part".

Entries.Title: Project Coffee
Entries.Description: Jaycee and Kendra don’t get along in a school project collaboration. Can they manage to team up if their grades and what they want to prove are at stake?
